### **About The Role**



Bespak is looking for an onsite, permanent, Technical Support Engineer on the Holmes Chapel site, CW4 8BE. The salary for this role is£60,000 to £70,000 per annum. Other benefits you will receive are 25 days leave plus bank holidays, discretionary annual bonus, generous 10% pension contribution, onsite free parking, and medical / dental / health / life assurance.


**Working Pattern** – **Days 37\.5 hours Monday to Thursday 8:30am to 5\.00pm Friday 8:30am to 3:45pm**

***Once you click apply, you will be redirected to our company website to make your application.***



As a **Technical Support Engineer** with a degree in Engineering, you will play a key role in ensuring our site operates safely, efficiently, and to the highest standards. This role goes beyond traditional facilities support, combining technical facilities engineering with responsibility for delivering site infrastructure and improvement projects.



Maintain critical infrastructure, building services, and utilities, ensuring reliability and compliance with UK regulatory, HSE, and GMP standards. As the work load increases the role will be split into two, one engineer focusing on supporting the BAU activities and one engineer focusing on the major construction projects.



Working cross\-functionally with Facilities, Manufacturing, HSE, and contractors, the role supports business growth and drives continuous improvement across cleanrooms and HVAC, water and process systems, CHP and site utilities, and energy management initiatives.


**As a Technical Support Engineer your duties will include:**


* Ensure safe, compliant, and efficient operation of site infrastructure, utilities, and building services.
* Champion health, safety, environmental, and GMP standards across all activities.
* Manage facilities projects from concept to completion — delivering on time and within budget.
* Lead contractor management, including permits, RAMS, and performance monitoring.
* Provide technical problem\-solving support and drive continuous improvement.
* Collaborate cross\-functionally with Manufacturing, QA, HSE, and Procurement.
* Support sustainability and energy efficiency initiatives across the site.


**Technical Support Engineer beneficial key skills and experience:**


* Degree or equivalent in Mechanical or Electrical Engineering
* Min 5 years experience in facilities, building services, maintenance, or project engineering.
* Strong knowledge of UK HSE legislation, contractor management, and risk control.
* Experience delivering engineering or facilities projects.
* Excellent organisational, problem\-solving, and stakeholder management skills.
* Proficient in MS Office and engineering systems (e.g. CAD, CAFM, asset management tools).


**Desirable:**


* Project management qualification (APM, PRINCE2, PMP).
* NEBOSH, IOSH, CDM, CSCS, or similar.
* Experience in GMP or cleanroom environments.
* Understanding of RIBA stages and building lifecycle management.


**Technical Support Engineer, Benefits:**



25 days annual holiday \+ bank holidays \+ Buy/Sell Scheme \| A generous employer pension contribution \| Private medical insurance \| Private dental Insurance \| Permanent Health Insurance \| Group life assurance \| Free will writing service \| Active well\-being programme \| Recognition awards \| Free Parking.



Holmes Chapel is a beautiful village in Cheshire with excellent transport links via its railway station on the Crewe\-Manchester Line, proximity to the motorway network and Manchester Airport. The National Parks of the Peak District, Lake District and Eryri (Snowdonia) are within easy reach. The village has a population of nearly 7,000 and offers various amenities, including supermarkets, shops, restaurants, schools, and a GP practice.



As an ethical employer we align our BZero sustainability initiative to the SBTI certification which means we are on a road to carbon reduction targeting net zero and are proud to be ISO certified in 14001, 45001 and 13485\.


***A full job description can be downloaded on the application Screen.***



Our core values are, Customer Focussed, Respectful, Collaborative, and Agile, these are woven into the fabric of our business and the values we measure ourselves by.



We are flexible. We understand that there is a life outside of work, so we aim to support you in attaining a happy work/life balance. To cater for employees’ individual circumstances, and where possible, we agree flexible working arrangements.



We value our inclusivity as we believe diversity should be embraced and celebrated. We live and work by these values and that’s what makes our company a great place to work.



We are proud to be a disability Positive employer. We will support you throughout the recruitment process with any adjustments you require therefore please contact the Recruitment Team if you require support.



By applying to this role, you are giving consent to Bespak Limited to process your personal data for employment/recruitment purposes only. All personal and sensitive data processed to Bespak is protected under GDPR regulations. To find out more about our privacy policy please visit our website or contact the local HR team.

jobs.title: Senior Cloud Software Developer
jobs.description:
**AVEVA is creating software trusted by over 90% of leading industrial companies.**

**Job Title: Senior Cloud Software Developer**

**Location: Cambridge,** **United Kingdom (Hybrid)**

**Employment Type: Full\-time**

 **The job**


Join AVEVA’s Core Services team to design and implement secure, resilient cloud platform capabilities using Microsoft Azure. This Senior\-level role is suited to an experienced developer with a strong record of delivering complex technical solutions and an interest in cloud development. You will work as part of an agile team, contribute to design decisions, build high\-quality services, and use modern engineering practices, including AI\-assisted development tools, to improve productivity and software quality.

 **Key responsibilities**

* Design, develop, and maintain secure, resilient features for AVEVA CONNECT Core Services

  

* Contribute to technical design and implementation decisions across cloud and service\-based architectures

  

* Build and improve services using modern engineering practices, including CI/CD and infrastructure as code

  

* Use AI\-assisted development tools to support engineering productivity, code quality, and delivery

  

* Work collaboratively in an agile development team and share knowledge on cloud technologies and practices.

 **Essential requirements**

* Strong design and coding skills, with a record of delivering high\-quality technical outcomes

  

* Experience developing microservice or service\-oriented architectures

  

* Good understanding of REST API design principles

  

* Experience with C\#/.NET or multiple programming languages, plus an understanding of database design, CI/CD, and infrastructure as code

  

* Experience with cloud development, especially Microsoft Azure

 **Desired skills and competencies**

* Experience with Kubernetes, containers, or cloud\-native application platforms

  

* Experience with Angular or an equivalent web development framework

  

* Experience using AI\-assisted coding tools to improve engineering productivity and software quality

  

* Strong communication, adaptability, curiosity, ownership, and motivation to solve technical challenges in a fast\-moving environment

  

We recognise that no candidate ticks every box. If you bring curiosity, ambition, and a willingness to grow, we’d love to hear from you.

 **R\&D at AVEVA**


Our global team of 2000\+ developers work on an incredibly diverse portfolio of over 75 industrial automation and engineering products, which cover everything from data management to 3D design. AI and cloud are at the centre of our strategy, and we have over 150 patents to our name.

  

Our track record of innovation is no fluke – it’s the result of a structured and deliberate focus on learning, collaboration and inclusivity. If you want to build applications that solve big problems, join us.

  

Find out more: aveva.com/en/about/careers/r\-and\-d\-careers/

 **UK Benefits include:**


Flexible benefits fund, emergency leave days, adoption leave, 28 days annual leave (plus bank holidays), pension, life cover, private medical insurance, parental leave, education assistance program.

  

It’s possible we’re hiring for this position in multiple countries, in which case the above benefits apply to the primary location. Specific benefits vary by country, but our packages are similarly comprehensive.

  

Find out more: aveva.com/en/about/careers/benefits/

 **Hybrid working**


We work in a hybrid way at AVEVA. Most roles are based at a local AVEVA office, with an expectation of being on\-site 50% of your working hours to support collaboration and connection. Some positions are fully office\-based depending on the nature of the work, and certain roles that support specific customers or markets may be remote. The working arrangement for this position will be confirmed during the hiring process.

 **Hiring process**


Interested? Great! Get started by submitting your cover letter and CV through our application portal. AVEVA is committed to recruiting and retaining people with disabilities. Please let us know in advance if you need reasonable support during your application process.

  

Find out more: aveva.com/en/about/careers/hiring\-process

 **About AVEVA**


AVEVA is a global leader in industrial software with more than 6,500 employees in over 40 countries. Our cutting\-edge solutions are used by thousands of enterprises to deliver the essentials of life – such as energy, infrastructure, chemicals, and minerals – safely, efficiently, and more sustainably.

  

We are committed to embedding sustainability and inclusion into our operations, our culture, and our core business strategy. Learn more about how we are progressing against our ambitious 2030 targets: sustainability\-report.aveva.com/

  

Find out more: aveva.com/en/about/careers/

  

AVEVA requires all successful applicants to undergo and pass a drug screening and comprehensive background check before they start employment. Background checks will be conducted in accordance with local laws and may, subject to those laws, include proof of educational attainment, employment history verification, proof of work authorization, criminal records, identity verification, credit check. Certain positions dealing with sensitive and/or third\-party personal data may involve additional background check criteria.

  

AVEVA is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to being an exemplary employer with an inclusive culture, developing a workplace environment where all our employees are treated with dignity and respect. We value diversity and the expertise that people from different backgrounds bring to our business. AVEVA provides reasonable accommodation to applicants with disabilities where appropriate. If you need reasonable accommodation for any part of the application and hiring process, please notify your recruiter. jobs.title: Architect & Senior Developer
jobs.description:
ADM unlocks the power of nature to enrich the quality of life. We’re a premier global human and animal nutrition company, delivering solutions today with an eye to the future. We’re blazing new trails in health and well\-being as our scientists develop groundbreaking products to support healthier living. We’re a cutting\-edge innovator leading the way to a new future of plant\-based consumer and industrial solutions to replace petroleum\-based products. We’re an unmatched agricultural supply chain manager and processor, providing food security by connecting local needs with global capabilities. And we’re a leader in sustainability, scaling across entire value chains to help decarbonize our industry and safeguard our planet. From the seed of the idea to the outcome of the solution, we give customers an edge in solving the nutritional and sustainability challenges of today and tomorrow. Learn more at www.adm.com

**The****Role**
  

An opportunity has arisen for an Architect \& Senior Developer in the IT Department in the City of London to design and deliver high\-quality software solutions across the firm’s trading, operational and regulatory landscape, with a focus on enhancing in\-house systems and integrating front, middle and back office platforms. The role includes responsibility for defining and evolving solution architecture, ensuring scalability, performance and alignment with architectural principles and best practices. You will collaborate closely with product owners, stakeholders and developers to translate requirements into secure, maintainable code and ensure robust, well\-documented releases.
  

  

Your Responsibilities
  

  

**Main Responsibilities:** (8\-10 key responsibilities)
* Oversee the firm's architecture across trading, clearing, and post\-trade systems and the integrations with CCPs, exchanges, data and platform vendors, as well as customers
* Direct the modernisation of integration patterns and frameworks, reinforcing strong security principles and practices
* Steer the data architecture strategy, supporting business objectives and ensuring data quality, ownership, security and accessibility.
* Chair architecture governance forums, encouraging participation and debate while driving timely, effective architectural decisions.
* Produce clear architecture documentation, architectural decision records, target\-state blueprints, and other artefacts for review and audit
* Design resilient systems meeting the firm's RTO/RPO requirements and FCA operational resilience obligations
* Meet regulatory obligations by design, including FCA/ESMA EMIR \& MiFID II requirements, DORA as well as other relevant, impactful global obligations
* Contribute to the firm’s change management and incident management frameworks.
* Mentor and upskill engineering teams on architecture principles, cloud\-native patterns, \& best practices
* Drive adoption of DevSecOps practices and infrastructure\-as\-code across the technology teams
* Support defining and governing the firm’s use of AI, ensuring solutions are secure, explainable, and compliant with regulatory expectations, data protection requirements, and internal risk guidance.
**Your Profile**
  

  

The successful candidate will possess the following:
* Deep domain knowledge of financial markets technology within an FCM, clearing broker, investment bank, exchange, or vendor
* Proven experience designing systems for listed derivatives, securities, and/or FX processing
* Thorough understanding of order processing, execution, risk management, margining, collateral, valuation and give\-up processing
* Strong knowledge of FIX protocol, along with CCP or vendor connectivity (e.g. ICE Clearing, Eurex, LME, CME etc)
* Extensive experience with event\-driven architectures, message brokers (Kafka, IBM MQ), and real\-time data pipelines
* Knowledge of UK/EU/US regulatory frameworks: EMIR, MiFID II, CASS, MAR, DORA, CFTC
* Proficiency in microservices architectures, as well as containerisation
* Cloud architecture expertise (preferably Azure), with experience migrating or running regulated financial workloads in cloud environments
* Expertise in .Net / C\# / SQL Server; React.js and Python desirable
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills; comfortable presenting to both C\-suite and technical stakeholders
* University degree (ideally in Computer Science or related field)
* 10\+ years of software engineering or infrastructure experience, with at least 3 years in a senior architecture role
**Your Future Perspective**
* Challenging tasks, short decision\-making processes and a high level of personal responsibility in a modern work environment with flexible work time models.
* Room for innovative thinking and growth with the possibility to manage your own career path.
* A company culture which promotes continuous learning and diversity. To assist with this all colleagues are able to join our Women’s and Multicultural Employee Resource Groups, and the ADM Pride Employee Network and the Young Professionals Network. As well as the company wide mentorship programme as mentor or mentee.
* Excellent career opportunities in a world leading nutrition company.
* An attractive remuneration including a variety of social benefits like subsidised health \& fitness offers.
* ADM is a company where managers and colleagues are encouraged to discuss and enable the flexibility that is needed to meet the demands of work and life.
* Additional benefits and support for maternity and paternity leave.
* ADM are an advocate of having a workforce who are aware of their mental health. In addition to our network of Mental Health First Aiders, all new starters to the business will be enrolled in ‘Mental Health Aware’ training within three months of joining the business.

Learn more about ADM at **www.adm.com**.
  

We are proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and value diversity at our company to encourage a diverse range of perspectives, skills, experience and knowledge within our business. To assist with this the Company has established a UK Diversity forum to support participation of underrepresented groups in the workplace. If you feel this job is for you, unlock your potential and apply now online informing us about your earliest possible entry date and salary expectation. By applying for this position, you agree to ADM’s privacy notice.
**\#IncludingYou**
  

  

Diversity, equity, inclusion and belonging are cornerstones of ADM’s efforts to continue innovating, driving growth, and delivering outstanding performance. We are committed to attracting and retaining a diverse workforce and create welcoming, truly inclusive work environments — environments that enable every ADM colleague to feel comfortable on the job, make meaningful contributions to our success, and grow their career. We respect and value the unique backgrounds and experiences that each person can bring to ADM because we know that diversity of perspectives makes us better, together.  

  

  



**About ADM**
  

  

At ADM, we unlock the power of nature to provide access to nutrition worldwide. With industry\-advancing innovations, a complete portfolio of ingredients and solutions to meet any taste, and a commitment to sustainability, we give customers an edge in solving the nutritional challenges of today and tomorrow. We’re a global leader in human and animal nutrition and the world’s premier agricultural origination and processing company. Our breadth, depth, insights, facilities and logistical expertise give us unparalleled capabilities to meet needs for food, beverages, health and wellness, and more. From the seed of the idea to the outcome of the solution, we enrich the quality of life the world over. Learn more at www.adm.com.

Before making an application, please browse all graduate opportunities available as we will only accept **one application** per candidate. Once you have made an application you will not be able to make changes to your selection or make a new application. The exception is if we open new vacancies in the new year.  



**To avoid missing out on your preferred role, we recommend applying** **as early as possible, as positions will close once filled.**

  

**Application process**

  

* Online strengths\-based assessment
* Application form
  

CVs and cover letters are not required as part of the application process. Candidates will be assessed through a single\-stage strengths\-based interview.

  

Start your career with a global, employee\-owned consultancy where your work can make a real difference. At Mott MacDonald, you'll work alongside experts, contribute to meaningful projects, and have the support, learning opportunities, and experience needed to grow your career from day one.

  

**Job Description**

  

Shape the Places Where People Thrive

  

At Mott MacDonald, we believe the built environment has the power to improve lives, strengthen communities, and create a more sustainable future. As a Graduate Building Physics Engineer, you'll help shape buildings, neighbourhoods, and cities that are comfortable, resilient, energy\-efficient, and designed with people and the planet in mind.

  

Join our growing Engineering Sciences team and become part of a community of specialists who use the principles of physics to solve some of the most important challenges facing the built environment. From creating healthier, more comfortable spaces and supporting the transition to net zero carbon, to helping cities adapt to climate change, your work will contribute to projects that make a meaningful difference to society.

  

Our team is proud to have worked on projects ranging from the Royal College of Art Battersea South building to supporting the NHS and public sector organisations in developing net zero carbon strategies, helping create lasting positive outcomes for communities today and for future generations.

  

**The Opportunity**

  

As a Graduate Building Physicist, you'll have the opportunity to develop your technical expertise while working alongside experienced specialists, designers, engineers, architects, and clients on a wide variety of exciting projects.

  

You'll be supported through structured learning, mentoring, and hands\-on project experience, gaining exposure to some of the latest digital tools and analytical techniques used to improve building performance and environmental outcomes.

  

From your first day, you'll be encouraged to contribute ideas, ask questions, and collaborate with colleagues who are passionate about sharing knowledge and helping others succeed.

  

**What You'll Do**

  

As part of our inclusive and multidisciplinary Engineering Sciences team, you'll help deliver design and strategic advice that enables clients to make informed, sustainable decisions.

  

Your responsibilities will include:

  

* Supporting the thermal modelling of buildings at a range of scales to evaluate thermal comfort, visual comfort, energy performance, climate resilience, and carbon impacts.
* Helping design teams identify practical and innovative solutions that improve building performance and user wellbeing.
* Assisting with qualitative building performance assessments during the early stages of design, providing valuable insights that influence key project decisions.
* Developing parametric modelling studies to support low\-carbon and net zero design strategies at building, campus, and masterplan scales.
* Supporting computational fluid dynamics (CFD) modelling to understand airflow and wind behaviour around buildings and urban environments.
* Contributing to studies that assess urban heat island effects and support the adaptation of cities and communities to future climate challenges.
* Working collaboratively with architects, engineers, planners, sustainability consultants, and stakeholders to develop integrated and impactful design solutions.
* Supporting senior team members in delivering projects across a diverse range of sectors and scales.
  

**Why This Role Matters**

  

Buildings and cities are responsible for a significant proportion of energy use and carbon emissions globally. The decisions made during the design process have lasting consequences for occupants, communities, and the environment.

  

**As a Building Physicist, you'll help create:**

  

* Healthier and more comfortable places for people to live, work, and learn.
* Buildings that consume less energy and emit less carbon.
* Communities that are more resilient to climate change and extreme weather.
* Sustainable developments that balance environmental, social, and economic objectives.
* Evidence\-based solutions that help clients make responsible decisions for the future.
  

Your work will directly contribute to improving quality of life while helping society progress towards a more sustainable and resilient future.

  

**Candidate Specification**

  

At Mott MacDonald, we’re looking for curious, motivated graduates who want to make a real difference. Join our purpose\-driven teams where your ideas matter, your growth is supported, and your work enhances the world we live in.

  

To be eligible for this opportunity, you will have less than 12 months’ relevant experience **(excluding placements**) and have a bachelors degree (obtained no earlier than 2025\) or expected to achieve one of the following degree disciplines:

  

* Building Physics
* Building Services Engineering
* Architectural Engineering
* Mechanical Engineering
* Environmental Engineering
* PhysicsSustainable
* Building Design
* Environmental Design and Engineering
* Mathematics or a related discipline
  

In your application, you should aim to demonstrate your genuine interest in both the opportunity and in joining Mott MacDonald. You can do this by highlighting any relevant experience or interests \- such as modules you've studied, previous work experience, or any research you've undertaken about our company, values, and projects.

  

We personally review every completed application form we receive as this part of our selection process is entirely human led – we do not use AI tools at this stage and kindly ask you not to either. We want you to answer each application question with authenticity so we can get to know the real you. Joining us as a graduate is your opportunity to shape your own story.

  

We are looking for graduates with the following strengths:


* Proactively takes initiative to complete tasks efficiently and independently.
* Communicates effectively and clearly with clients and colleagues.
* Delivers high quality written work with strong attention to detail and clarity.
* Demonstrates a structured and analytical approach to problem solving.
  

**UK Immigration**


Mott MacDonald Ltd. are not currently offering sponsorship to candidates under the Skilled Worker visa route in the UK. This decision is as a consequence of the changes made to the Skilled Worker route by the UK Government in April 2024\.


Our ethos is to develop, train and retain our graduates and therefore we are looking for a long\-term relationship with our graduates. For this reason, we cannot accept applications from candidates who would be working under the Graduate visa route or other time\-limited visas, (irrespective of visa duration), due to their temporary nature and the requirement for sponsorship under the Skilled Worker route in future.


We continue to welcome applications from candidates who are eligible for alternative immigration routes in the UK, that do not require sponsorship as a Skilled Worker now or in future.

  

**AI Usage**


At Mott MacDonald, we see the value AI can bring, but we take a people\-first approach to hiring. While AI tools can help candidates prepare and build confidence, every application and hiring decision is reviewed by our recruitment and hiring teams. We encourage the responsible use of AI while ensuring we get to know the real person behind the application.

  

**Accessibility**

We want you to feel supported and able to perform at your best throughout our recruitment process. If there is anything we can do to make applying or interviewing with us more accessible, please contact us at **reasonable.adjustments@mottmac.com** and we'll be happy to discuss how we can help.

  

**About your development**


A graduate position should be more than just a job. We know this and so do you. That’s why with our graduate roles we aim to give you the experience and technical knowledge you need to progress your career. From the moment you join us, you’ll receive the training you need. You will be assigned a mentor, who will guide you to meet the objectives of your professional training needs. You will join our three\-year early careers soft skills development programme – Accelerating your Future, which is designed to give you the skills and tools necessary for a long\-lasting successful career here at Mott MacDonald.

  

**Our social side**

  

  

Being part of Mott MacDonald means more than just work; there’s a huge range of fun and exciting things that you can get involved in.


From the moment you join us, you’ll have the opportunity to expand your social and professional network, whether it’s meeting other graduates or joining forces with other members of staff from around the company at our annual sports day. Each of our offices have a sports and social committee which will give you the chance to be part of a variety of sports, social and charity events. We’re committed to promoting a strong culture of social responsibility and encourage our staff to play active roles in the local community.


It's worth noting that sports and social committees tend to vary from office to office, so as well as getting involved in what’s already on offer, don’t be afraid to suggest new events or initiatives that you think could be a great addition. It doesn’t stop there. From your first day, you’ll have access to Perks at Work, giving you discounts on cinema tickets, travel, utilities and much more, helping you make the most of our employee benefits.

  

**Agile working**

At Mott MacDonald, we believe it makes business sense for you and your manager to choose how you can work most effectively to meet your client, team, and personal commitments. We offer a hybrid working policy that embraces your well\-being, flexibility, and trust.

  

**Equality, diversity, and inclusion**


We put equality, diversity, and inclusion at the heart of our business, seeking to promote fair employment procedures and practices to ensure equal opportunities for all. We encourage individual expression in our workplace and are committed to creating an inclusive environment where **everyone** feels they can contribute.

  

**We offer some fantastic benefits including:**

  

**Financial wellbeing**


* **Biannual salary reviews:** We believe hard work should be recognised and rewarded. To support your development and progression, you'll be eligible for salary reviews twice a year during your first three years with us, subject to successfully completing your probation period.
* We match employee pension contributions between 4\.5% and 7%.
* Life assurance equal up to 4 x your basic salary, with an option to increase the level of cover to 6 x your salary.
* Our income protection scheme provides a financial benefit, as well as absence and return to work support due to long\-term illness or injury.
* Flexible benefits, including increased life assurance cover, critical illness insurance, payroll saving and will writing.

At Mott MacDonald, we’re committed to shaping a better world—one that’s sustainable, inclusive, and impactful. Our nuclear division plays a pivotal role in delivering complex, high\-profile projects that support the transition to a low\-carbon, net\-zero future. From decommissioning and refurbishment to new build development and advanced nuclear technologies, our work is creating a legacy for generations to come.

  

We’re looking for passionate Graduate Nuclear Safety Engineers to join our growing team. This is your opportunity to contribute to some of the most innovative and meaningful energy projects in the UK and globally, while developing your career in a supportive, caring, and empowering environment.

  

As a Graduate Nuclear Safety Engineer, you’ll be involved in a wide range of impactful projects, including:

  

* Supporting the delivery of major nuclear programmes across the full project lifecycle.
* Collaborating with multidisciplinary teams on design, construction, operations, and decommissioning.
* Contributing to the development of cutting\-edge nuclear technologies.
* Preparing high\-quality technical documentation, reports, and specifications.
* Engaging with clients and stakeholders to deliver trusted, responsible solutions.
* Participating in site visits and client meetings as required.
**Candidate Specification**

  

At Mott MacDonald, we’re looking for curious, motivated graduates who want to make a real difference. Join our purpose\-driven teams where your ideas matter, your growth is supported, and your work enhances the world we live in.

  

To be eligible for this opportunity, you will have less than 12 months’ relevant experience **(excluding placements**) and have a masters degree (obtained no earlier than 2025\) or expected to achieve one of the following degree disciplines:

  

* Nuclear Engineering
* Chemical and Process Engineering
* Mechanical Engineeing or
* Physics
  

This opportunity will require you to be eligible to achieve security clearance. Security clearance is dictated by the types of projects we work on and normally requires you to be a UK British national or lived in the UK for five years or more.

  

In your application, you should aim to demonstrate your genuine interest in both the opportunity and in joining Mott MacDonald. You can do this by highlighting any relevant experience or interests \- such as modules you've studied, previous work experience, or any research you've undertaken about our company, values, and projects.

  

We personally review every completed application form we receive as this part of our selection process is entirely human led – we do not use AI tools at this stage and kindly ask you not to either. We want you to answer each application question with authenticity so we can get to know the real you. Joining us as a graduate is your opportunity to shape your own story.

  

We are looking for graduates with the following strengths:

  

* Proactively takes initiative to complete tasks efficiently and independently.
* Communicates effectively and clearly with clients and colleagues.
* Delivers high quality written work with strong attention to detail and clarity.
* Demonstrates a structured and analytical approach to problem solving.
* Understanding of energy infrastructure and the energy sector
  

**UK Immigration**


Mott MacDonald Ltd. are not currently offering sponsorship to candidates under the Skilled Worker visa route in the UK. This decision is as a consequence of the changes made to the Skilled Worker route by the UK Government in April 2024\.


Our ethos is to develop, train and retain our graduates and therefore we are looking for a long\-term relationship with our graduates. For this reason, we cannot accept applications from candidates who would be working under the Graduate visa route or other time\-limited visas, (irrespective of visa duration), due to their temporary nature and the requirement for sponsorship under the Skilled Worker route in future.


We continue to welcome applications from candidates who are eligible for alternative immigration routes in the UK, that do not require sponsorship as a Skilled Worker now or in future.

  

**AI Usage**


At Mott MacDonald, we see the value AI can bring, but we take a people\-first approach to hiring. While AI tools can help candidates prepare and build confidence, every application and hiring decision is reviewed by our recruitment and hiring teams. We encourage the responsible use of AI while ensuring we get to know the real person behind the application.

  

**Accessibility**

We want you to feel supported and able to perform at your best throughout our recruitment process. If there is anything we can do to make applying or interviewing with us more accessible, please contact us at **reasonable.adjustments@mottmac.com** and we'll be happy to discuss how we can help.

  

**About your development**


A graduate position should be more than just a job. We know this and so do you. That’s why with our graduate roles we aim to give you the experience and technical knowledge you need to progress your career. From the moment you join us, you’ll receive the training you need. You will be assigned a mentor, who will guide you to meet the objectives of your professional training needs. You will join our three\-year early careers soft skills development programme – Accelerating your Future, which is designed to give you the skills and tools necessary for a long\-lasting successful career here at Mott MacDonald.

  

**Our social side**

  

  

Being part of Mott MacDonald means more than just work; there’s a huge range of fun and exciting things that you can get involved in.


From the moment you join us, you’ll have the opportunity to expand your social and professional network, whether it’s meeting other graduates or joining forces with other members of staff from around the company at our annual sports day. Each of our offices have a sports and social committee which will give you the chance to be part of a variety of sports, social and charity events. We’re committed to promoting a strong culture of social responsibility and encourage our staff to play active roles in the local community.


It's worth noting that sports and social committees tend to vary from office to office, so as well as getting involved in what’s already on offer, don’t be afraid to suggest new events or initiatives that you think could be a great addition. It doesn’t stop there. From your first day, you’ll have access to Perks at Work, giving you discounts on cinema tickets, travel, utilities and much more, helping you make the most of our employee benefits.

  

**Agile working**

At Mott MacDonald, we believe it makes business sense for you and your manager to choose how you can work most effectively to meet your client, team, and personal commitments. We offer a hybrid working policy that embraces your well\-being, flexibility, and trust.

  

**Equality, diversity, and inclusion**


We put equality, diversity, and inclusion at the heart of our business, seeking to promote fair employment procedures and practices to ensure equal opportunities for all. We encourage individual expression in our workplace and are committed to creating an inclusive environment where **everyone** feels they can contribute.

  

**We offer some fantastic benefits including:**

  

**Financial wellbeing**


* **Biannual salary reviews:** We believe hard work should be recognised and rewarded. To support your development and progression, you'll be eligible for salary reviews twice a year during your first three years with us, subject to successfully completing your probation period.
* We match employee pension contributions between 4\.5% and 7%.
* Life assurance equal up to 4 x your basic salary, with an option to increase the level of cover to 6 x your salary.
* Our income protection scheme provides a financial benefit, as well as absence and return to work support due to long\-term illness or injury.
* Flexible benefits, including increased life assurance cover, critical illness insurance, payroll saving and will writing.
* As an independently owned business we share the financial success of the business with all our colleagues in various ways including annual bonus schemes.
  

**Employee Ownership**


* Our employee ownership model means no external investors, just us, creating a culture of shared success.
* Our employees have a stake and a voice in our business, giving them a direct connection to our success through our personal and group performance bonuses.
* As your career grows, so does your stake, recognising your long\-term impact and contribution.
* Your voice matters, with the opportunity to connect directly with senior leadership through formal channels to help shape our future.
* For our senior roles you will have a direct pathway towards ownership from day one.
  

**Health and wellbeing**


* Private medical insurance for all UK colleagues.
* Health cash plan to support you with every day health costs and treatments.
* Access to Peppy, providing free support from menopause experts for all UK colleagues.
* A variety of wellbeing support is available through our comprehensive wellbeing program, including access for you and your family.
* Ability to flex your salary to opt into a wide range of health benefits, many of which can be extended to your family too.
  

**Lifestyle**

* 33 days holiday each year, inclusive of public holidays and dependent on level, with the ability to buy or sell leave through our flexible benefits programme.
* 10 days additional paid leave for Armed Forces Reservists and Cadet Force Adult Volunteers.
* Holiday entitlement increased to a minimum of 35 days after 5 years’ service.
* Variety of employee saving schemes and discounts from high\-street retailers.
  

**Enhanced family and carers leave**


* Enhanced family leave policies, including 26 weeks paid maternity and adoption leave, and two weeks paid paternity/partner leave.
* Our shared parental leave matches maternity leave meaning we pay up to 24 weeks at full pay.
* Up to five additional days leave are provided for those with significant caring responsibilities, two of which are paid.
* We offer policies and dedicated support to help military families balance service life with career and wellbeing.
  

**Learning and development**


* Primary annual professional institution subscription.
* A broad range of opportunities to enhance both technical and soft skills through mentoring, formal training, and self\-development options.
  

**Networks, communities, and social outcomes**


* Join a wide range of groups including our Advanced Employee Networks which support our LGBTQ\+, gender, race and ethnicity, disability, and parents/carers communities.
* We are proud signatories of the Armed Forces Covenant and Gold Award holders in the MOD Employer Recognition Scheme, supported by our dedicated internal Armed Forces Network.
* Make a difference within our communities through our social outcomes.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer
jobs.description:
**Company Description**  

We’re the world’s leading sports technology company, at the intersection between sports, media, and betting. More than 1,700 sports federations, media outlets, betting operators, and consumer platforms across 120 countries rely on our know\-how and technology to boost their business.

 **Job Description**  

Senior Software Engineer (.NET)

**Competition Management \& Digital Engagement (CMDE) \| Sportradar**


Company Description


We're the world's leading sports technology company, at the intersection between sports, media, and betting. More than 1,700 sports federations, media outlets, betting operators, and consumer platforms across 120 countries rely on our know\-how and technology to boost their business.  



About CMDE


Competition Management \& Digital Engagement (CMDE) is a key engineering organization within Sportradar. We build and operate products that help sports organizations manage competitions, run tournaments, distribute sports content, and deliver high\-quality digital experiences for fans.


Working with federations, leagues, governing bodies, event organizers, and other sports organizations, our teams develop reliable platforms for competition administration, scheduling, results management, statistics, content distribution, and fan\-facing experiences.


Our systems support complex operational environments and must remain dependable, adaptable, and easy to operate at scale.


The Challenge


This is a role for an experienced developer who wants to own things, not just deliver them. You will take complex technical initiatives from design through production, work across a high\-performing distributed team, and influence the architecture and engineering practices of strategically important CMDE platforms.


You will remain hands\-on while helping modernize systems, improve reliability, and translate competition\-management needs into scalable software capabilities.


Key Responsibilities

* Design, build, and operate scalable, high\-performance services and applications using C\# and .NET.
* Take independent ownership of complex technical initiatives from initial design through production delivery and continuous improvement.
* Contribute to architecture decisions across distributed systems, APIs, cloud platforms, and event\-driven services.
* Guide platform modernization while balancing delivery needs, operational risk, technical debt, and long\-term maintainability.
* Mentor engineers through code review, pairing, design guidance, and constructive feedback.
* Drive improvements in reliability, security, observability, performance, testing, and engineering practices.
* Collaborate with product, engineering, and business stakeholders to connect technical decisions with customer and organizational value.
* Build expertise across competition management, tournament operations, scheduling, results, statistics, and digital engagement.


About You


You are an experienced software developer who can independently design, build, and operate complex software systems. You combine deep .NET expertise with pragmatic judgment, enjoy solving challenging technical problems, and can influence engineering decisions beyond your immediate deliverables.


You communicate clearly, help other engineers grow, and understand that engineering excellence includes coperability, customer outcomes, and sustainable delivery.


Required Experience and Expertise

* 15\+ years of professional software development experience, including responsibility for business\-critical production systems.
* Expert\-level knowledge of C\#, .NET, APIs, asynchronous programming, performance, testing, and modern software design practices.
* Proven ability to design and operate distributed systems in production using cloud platforms and contemporary architecture patterns.
* Independent ownership of complex initiatives, from architecture and delivery through production operation and incident learning.
* A strong record of mentoring engineers and conducting technical reviews that are direct, constructive, and useful.
* Clear communication with technical and non\-technical stakeholders, including the ability to explain trade\-offs and build alignment around difficult decisions.
* Experience with sports technology, competition\-management platforms, enterprise SaaS, or similarly complex operational domains.
* Demonstrated Snooker domain expertise, including competition structures, tournament formats, scheduling, scoring, results, statistics, and operational workflows.


Our Offer

* A collaborative environment with colleagues from around the world, including engineering offices in Europe, Asia, and the United States.
* The ability to shape your own workday and career through a clearly defined professional and personal development plan.
* Opportunity to work with senior leadership and influence strategically important competition\-management platforms.
* A vibrant and inclusive community, including Women in Tech and Pride groups that welcome all participants.
* Flexible working hours.


Sportradar \| Competition Management \& Digital Engagement

 **Additional Information** *At Sportradar, we celebrate our diverse group of hardworking employees. Sportradar is committed to ensuring equal access to its programs, facilities, and employment opportunities. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or status as a protected veteran. jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer (.NET/C#) - Logistics team
jobs.description:
Location:
Warszawa, PL, 00\-841
Company: Opennet.pl Sp. z o.o.
Team: Technology
Contract Type: Employee
**About the job:**
------------------

  

**We are part of Allegro and we are specialists in providing advanced IT systems for logistics management.**

  

* **Massive Scale**: Design and build high\-availability systems used by tens of thousands of users. This is high\-performance engineering in practice.
* **Modern Tech Stack**: Work with a world\-class environment using C\#, .NET Core, ASP.NET, REST, PostgreSQL, Azure, Docker, Kubernetes, EntityFramework, and Redis.
* **True Ownership \& Autonomy**: We live by a "you build it, you run it" philosophy. You'll join an autonomous team with full ownership of the services you create, from design to deployment.
* **Complex Challenges**: You will tackle complex backend problems, using technology to solve real\-world business challenges.

Join the team building the technological foundation of Allegro One logistics! Our systems support the end\-to\-end parcel flow \- from pickup through sorting, depots, and last\-mile delivery. Processing millions of logistics events daily, our backend services directly impact stability and efficiency for thousands of couriers, warehouse workers, and drivers.


You will have a chance to build and refine the high\-performance infrastructure powering our logistics network. We prioritize high reliability, modern engineering practices, and a supportive team culture. This role offers an excellent opportunity to actively shape our backend architecture while solving high\-scale challenges.


**Important things for you:**
-----------------------------

  

* Flexible working hours in the hybrid model (4/1\) \- working hours start between 7:00 a.m. and 10:00 a.m. We also have 30 days of occasional remote work.
* The salary range for this position depending on the skill set is as follows (contract of employment, tax\-deductible cost):


	+ PLN 18 850 \- 25 900
	+ Annual bonus based on your annual performance and company results.
	+ Long term discretionary incentive plan based on Allegro.eu shares (restricted stock units).
* Our team is based in Warsaw.
**We are looking for people who have:**
---------------------------------------

  

* **Core Technical Stack \& Architecture:** Extensive experience architecting high\-throughput, low\-latency backend systems using **C\# and .NET Core / ASP.NET Core**; mastery of resilient **RESTful APIs**, modular monoliths, and microservices; deep expertise in relational database optimization using **PostgreSQL and Entity Framework Core** under high\-concurrency workloads; pragmatic experience with legacy protocols (**SOAP/WCF**).
* **Infrastructure \& Distributed Systems:** Hands\-on production experience in cloud\-native environments using **Docker, Kubernetes, and CI/CD**; strong background in event\-driven architectures and distributed messaging via **Azure Service Bus** or Kafka; solid grasp of caching and optimization techniques to ensure high availability and eventual consistency.
* **Mobile \& Platform Integration:** Understanding of backend considerations for mobile integration, including payload optimization, offline synchronization, push notification architectures, and API versioning.
* **Leadership \& Delivery:** Proven technical leadership in mentoring engineers, driving code quality, and leading architectural reviews; full ownership across the SDLC from design to delivery; fluent in English (at least B2\).
**What’s in it for you:**
-------------------------

  

* Well\-located offices (with e.g. fully equipped kitchens, bicycle parking, terraces full of greenery) and excellent work tools (e.g., raised desks, ergonomic chairs, interactive conference rooms).
* A Dell Laptop (Windows) and all the necessary accessories.
* A wide selection of fringe benefits in a cafeteria plan \- you choose what you like (e.g., medical, sports or lunch packages, insurance, purchase vouchers).
* English classes that we pay for related to the specific nature of your job.
* A training budget, inter\-team tourism (see more here), hackathons, and an internal learning platform where you will find multiple trainings.
* An additional day off for volunteering, which you can use alone, with a team, or with a larger group of people connected by a common goal.
* Social events for Allegro people \- Spin Kilometers, Family Day, Fat Thursday, Advent of Code, and many other occasions we enjoy.

  

And that's just the beginning! You can read more about the benefits here.


**\#goodtobehere means that:**
------------------------------

  

* **You will join a team you can count on** \- we work with top\-class specialists who have knowledge\- and experience\-sharing in their DNA.
* **You will love our level of autonomy** in team organization, the space for continuous development, and the opportunity to try new things. You get to choose which technology solves the problem and you are responsible for what you create.
* **You will value our Developer Experience** and the full platform of tools and technologies that make creating software easier. We rely on an internal ecosystem based on self\-service and widely used tools such as Kubernetes, Docker, Consul, GitHub, and GitHub Actions. Thanks to this, you can contribute to Allegro from your very first days on the job.
* **You will be equipped with modern AI tools** to automate repetitive tasks, allowing you to focus on developing new services and refining existing ones (also leveraging AI support).
* **You will create solutions that will be used (and loved!)** by your friends, family and millions of our customers.
* **You will meet the Allegro Scale**, which starts with over 1000 microservices, an open\-source data bus (Hermes) with 300K\+ rps, a Service Mesh with 1M\+ rps, tens of petabytes of data, and production\-used machine learning.
* **You will become part of Allegro Tech** \- We speak at industry conferences, cooperate with tech communities, run our own blog (it's been over 10 years!), record podcasts, lead guilds, and we organize our own internal conference \- the Allegro Tech Meeting. We create solutions we love (and can) to talk about!

**Send us your CV and… see you at Allegro!**


**Don’t wait until you join us! Let's meet online!**
----------------------------------------------------


Get to know our team, take a peek at our office life and check out what else we do at Allegro.

jobs.title: .NET-utvecklare till riskbedömning
jobs.description:
**Att jobba som . NET utvecklare**


Vill du utveckla moderna försäkringslösningar och samtidigt få möjlighet att påverka både teknik och arbetssätt?


Hos oss blir du en del av ett erfaret team där samarbete, kunskapsdelning och dialog är en naturlig del av vardagen. Du får arbeta nära verksamheten och användarna, vilket ger dig snabb återkoppling på det du utvecklar och möjlighet att se hur dina lösningar används i praktiken.


Här får du dessutom vara med i en spännande teknisk förflyttning. Vi har lanserat den första versionen av vårt nya riskbedömningssystem och fortsätter nu utvecklingen samtidigt som äldre lösningar successivt ersätts.

**Därför kan det här vara jobbet för dig:**

* Du får kombinera nyutveckling och förvaltning och följa lösningar hela vägen från kod till produktion.
* Du arbetar med verksamhetskritiska lösningar som bland annat används för digital hälsodeklaration och medicinsk riskbedömning.
* Du får arbeta i ett erfaret team med nära samarbete och frekvent feedback från verksamheten.
* Du får möjlighet att bredda din kompetens mellan .NET och React, oavsett om din tyngdpunkt idag ligger inom backend eller frontend.
* Du har flera möjliga utvecklingsvägar framåt, exempelvis mot systemansvar, Scrum Master eller mjukvaruarkitektur.


Som .NET\-utvecklare arbetar du med utveckling och förvaltning av applikationerna i teamets portfölj. En viktig del är vår digitala hälsodeklaration och vårt riskbedömningssystem med regelmotor och handläggarstöd. Rollen innebär att du successivt bygger upp förståelse för helheten och tar ansvar för lösningarna även efter att de gått i produktion.

**Dina huvudsakliga arbetsuppgifter är att:**

* utveckla och vidareutveckla lösningar i .NET och React
* arbeta med felsökning, incidenthantering och förvaltning
* testa din egen kod och delta aktivt i code reviews
* hantera release och deploy samt arbeta med Azure DevOps och Octopus Deploy
* arbeta med SQL, integrationer och teamets olika applikationer
* samarbeta med bland annat riskbedömare, processägare och andra utvecklingsteam
* bidra med idéer, feedback och problemlösning tillsammans med dina kollegor.


Vi är 8 personer i teamet som består av bland annat utvecklare, testare, Product Owner, Scrum Master och mjukvaruarkitekt. Vi utgår från vårt huvudkontor på Kungsholmen i Stockholm och arbetar hybrid, med en kombination av arbete på kontoret och på distans. Du rapporterar till gruppchef IT inom IT Risk \& Hälsa.

**För att lyckas i rollen**


Vi söker dig med omkring fem års erfarenhet av systemutveckling och som relativt snabbt kan bidra i teamets leveranser. Du har erfarenhet av .NET\-utveckling och gärna React, men det viktiga är att du är nyfiken på helheten och vill utvecklas över gränserna mellan frontend och backend.


Du behöver kunna kommunicera väl på svenska i tal och skrift. Kunskaper inom SQL, Azure DevOps, CI/CD och releasehantering eller motsvarande är värdefulla eftersom du arbetar med hela utvecklingskedjan. Erfarenhet från försäkringsbranschen är meriterande.


Som person är du är noggrann, ansvarstagande och problemlösningsorienterad med förmåga att självständigt planera ditt arbete. Du söker orsaken när problem uppstår och tar dem vidare till en lösning, vilket är viktigt i arbetet med nyutveckling, förvaltning, felsökning och incidenthantering.


Samarbete och kommunikation är en naturlig del av rollen. Du delar kunskap, lyfter frågor och kan ge och ta emot feedback på ett konstruktivt sätt. Vi uppskattar också din nyfikenhet och vilja att sätta dig in i nya områden och förstå helheten.

**Vad händer nu?**


Vi jobbar med löpande urval så tveka inte att skicka in din ansökan redan idag. I ansökan kommer vi att ställa ett antal urvalsfrågor som ligger till grund för första urvalet.


Läs mer om hela vår rekryteringsprocess här.


Om du har frågor kring rollen, vänligen kontakta rekryterande chef (namn på chefen) på (mailadress).


Om du har frågor kopplat till rekryteringsprocess, vänligen ta kontakt med rekryterande chef Patric Wu via patric.wu@skandia.se eller Talent Acquisition Partner på madelene.skogh@skandia.se.


Vi kommer att återkoppla till alla som söker oavsett om du går vidare eller inte.


Vi ser fram emot din ansökan!

jobs.title: AI-First Senior Software Engineer
jobs.description:
Nion is an IT consultancy with offices in Stockholm, Malmö, Gothenburg, Skopje, Bitola and Sofia, where 200\+ IT specialists work together to deliver tailored digital solutions. Our clients operate in industries such as telecom, fintech and insurance, and we help organisations simplify complex challenges and create real business value.


We're looking for an experienced **AI\-First Senior Software Engineer** for our Stockholm office.


This is not a "coder" role. Our position is deliberate: the era ahead needs software *engineers*, not software *developers*. AI has hyper\-accelerated the software cycle — but it cannot hold accountability. The engineer does. With AI handling most code generation, human attention becomes the scarce resource and moves upstream and downstream of the keyboard: to priorities, trade\-off decisions, governance and final judgment, while agents handle execution in between.


Your job is to do what AI cannot — set direction, make the judgement calls, and keep acceleration from turning into compounding risk across functionality, security, compliance, maintainability and knowledge continuity. The Factory's goal is accelerated, secure and *sustainable* software delivery, and you are the person who holds that line.

**What you'll do**

* **System design.** Own the big picture — how components fit together, how data flows, how failures propagate. Modularity, standards and flexibility, not just the unit of code in front of you.
* **Domain modelling.** Understand the client's business problem deeply enough to design the *right* solution, not just a working one. Widening the problem context is where the real advantage is.
* **Architectural patterns.** Know which patterns to apply, when and why. As AI produces design artefacts faster than organisations can evaluate trade\-offs, your role shifts toward decision engineering — choosing and validating, not just producing.
* **Process design — the core responsibility.** Design the repeatable process by which software gets built, tested, deployed and maintained. In practice this means designing and orchestrating agentic coding flows, including patterns such as *orchestrator–worker* (an orchestrator decides sub\-tasks, initiates them and synthesises results) and *evaluator–optimizer* (one model generates, a second evaluates and feeds back, and the loop iterates). You decide where a deterministic workflow is right versus a more autonomous agent.
* **Quality judgment.** Know what good looks like, recognise when AI output is wrong, and have the discipline to reject it. Quality control moves from line\-by\-line review toward designing tests, feedback loops and validation checkpoints.
* **Tooling — the right tool for the job.** Fluency across product\-development tools, AI\-acceleration (code\-generation) tools, infrastructure tools and quality\-control tools. The best results come when tools have full access to the specific codebase and knowledge base — and well\-structured, standardised codebases yield the largest gains.
* **Accountability.** You hold accountability — not the AI. Put bluntly: vibe coding is not software engineering.

**Your profile**

* 8\+ years of hands\-on software engineering, with deep fundamentals in architecture, system design, modularity and standards (non\-negotiable — AI amplifies skill, it doesn't substitute for it)
* An early adopter of AI\-first development, with **proven, in\-production experience implementing AI\-first software development processes** — not just experimenting with tooling
* Demonstrable experience designing and orchestrating agentic / AI\-assisted development workflows (orchestrator–worker, evaluator–optimizer, and workflow\-vs\-agent decisions)
* Strong critical evaluation of AI output and the discipline to reject it
* Test design, feedback\-loop design and validation skills over line\-by\-line review
* Security, compliance and maintainability awareness in AI\-accelerated pipelines
* Infrastructure / CI\-CD fluency and the ability to work across the full SDLC
* Domain\-modelling ability — translating a business problem into the right technical solution
* Prompt and context engineering as a working skill, not a novelty
* Strong collaboration and communication, with deep client and product integration
* Fluent in Swedish and English, written and spoken

**Tools you'll work with**

* **AI\-acceleration:** Claude Code, agentic coding tools and LLM platforms (Anthropic Claude, OpenAI / Azure OpenAI)
* **Languages \& engineering:** .NET, Java or Python at senior depth, with strong Git and code\-review practice
* **Workflow orchestration:** agent frameworks and multi\-step orchestration (orchestrator–worker, evaluator–optimizer patterns)
* **Infrastructure:** CI/CD pipelines, Docker, Kubernetes
* **Quality control:** automated testing, evaluation and validation frameworks for AI\-assisted output

**Meritorious**

* Anthropic Claude certification or equivalent AI platform credentials
* Experience standing up AI\-first processes at team or organisation scale
* LLM evaluation, guardrails and testing strategy experience
* Domain experience in telecom, fintech or insurance
* Prior consulting or client\-facing delivery experience

**What this role is not**


It is not a prompt\-driven "code typist," and it is not someone who ships unreviewed AI output. Used incorrectly, AI tools make a codebase *less* reliable, and automated processes compound that risk. Your judgement, ownership and process design are the product.

**We're looking for someone who is**

* Professional and committed to delivering solutions that meet real business needs
* Accountable and self\-driven — you take ownership of the big things and the small things
* Communicative and a team player; resilient under the cognitive load of carrying large context (we build teams with fail\-over and redundancy, because AI burn\-out is real)
* Flexible and open to some travel in connection with client projects

**With us you get**

* A collaborative, flat organisation where support is a given. Your consultant manager acts as a mentor to ensure your professional development and wellbeing.
* A clear career path and continuous learning through projects, mentorship and skills development.
* A vibrant company culture with strong team spirit, knowledge sharing and social activities that make work fun.

**Selected benefits**

* Opportunity for part\-ownership
* Competitive fixed salary
* 30 days holiday
* Company laptop, phone and subscription


Ready for the next step in your career? Send us your application.


Engineering judgement, accelerated — that's how we make IT easy.

jobs.title: CRM Solutions Developer
jobs.description:
Aurobay develops and produces world\-class hybrid engines and transmissions. With factories on two continents \- Sweden and China \- we're a pioneering global supplier of propulsion technology, development services and contract manufacturing. The Aurobay brand brings together over 9,000 dedicated and determined people that design, develop, and manufacture next\-generation powertrain solutions for a global market.


Aurobay is part of HORSE Powertrain Limited, a global leader in powertrain solutions. The Group has 19,000 employees, 17 plants and 5 R\&D centers across three continents. We partner with OEM customers around the world and offer innovative solutions that can cater to up to 80% of the growing hybrid and combustion powertrain market, enabling a faster transition toward cleaner mobility.


At Aurobay, we are committed to diversity and inclusion. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and believe that different perspectives and experiences make for a stronger, more innovative company.


We are looking for a CRM Solutions Developer who combines hands\-on software development with strong experience in CRM platforms such as Hubspot or SalesForce, Power Platform, Azure, APIs, and system integrations. jobs.description:
**Att jobba som . NET utvecklare**


Vill du utveckla moderna försäkringslösningar och samtidigt få möjlighet att påverka både teknik och arbetssätt?


Hos oss blir du en del av ett erfaret team där samarbete, kunskapsdelning och dialog är en naturlig del av vardagen. Du får arbeta nära verksamheten och användarna, vilket ger dig snabb återkoppling på det du utvecklar och möjlighet att se hur dina lösningar används i praktiken.


Här får du dessutom vara med i en spännande teknisk förflyttning. Vi har lanserat den första versionen av vårt nya riskbedömningssystem och fortsätter nu utvecklingen samtidigt som äldre lösningar successivt ersätts.


**Därför kan det här vara jobbet för dig:**


* Du får kombinera nyutveckling och förvaltning och följa lösningar hela vägen från kod till produktion.
* Du arbetar med verksamhetskritiska lösningar som bland annat används för digital hälsodeklaration och medicinsk riskbedömning.

* Du får möjlighet att bredda din kompetens mellan .NET och React, oavsett om din tyngdpunkt idag ligger inom backend eller frontend.
* Du har flera möjliga utvecklingsvägar framåt, exempelvis mot systemansvar, Scrum Master eller mjukvaruarkitektur.

Som .NET\-utvecklare arbetar du med utveckling och förvaltning av applikationerna i teamets portfölj. En viktig del är vår digitala hälsodeklaration och vårt riskbedömningssystem med regelmotor och handläggarstöd. * utveckla och vidareutveckla lösningar i .NET och React
* arbeta med felsökning, incidenthantering och förvaltning
* testa din egen kod och delta aktivt i code reviews
* hantera release och deploy samt arbeta med Azure DevOps och Octopus Deploy

Low\-code is a way for a bank to move fast without cutting corners. Our team makes that possible. Join us in the Power Platform team, where we work with platform adoption, governance and support, to make sure good ideas don’t end up gathering dust on a shelf or take a year to reach production.



SEB is more than just a bank with an IT function. We are a progressive tech company powered by innovation and fuelled by collaboration. From COBOL to AI and everything in between, we offer you an impressive tech stack and several technology paths. Together we're innovating for a sustainable society and building the tech arena of the future, a welcoming space for everyone. Are you ready to take on a new challenge? If so, you'll be interested in this opportunity!  

  

**About the role:**  

As a Power Platform developer in our Center of Excellence, you join a team that owns the platform end to end. We handle administration and governance on the platform, and we work with business units across the bank to help them build apps, automations and AI agents that support our transformation journey.



This is a developer role, but expect to spend a lot of time alongside other teams rather than in your own backlog. You will help projects and initiatives to succeed by providing support, guidance and training. Some weeks that might mean co\-building, other weeks it could mean workshops, and sometimes it’s an honest conversation about why something shouldn’t be built the way it’s been drawn up.

  

**In this role you will:**



* Run enablement in practice: workshops, templates, reusable patterns, development standards, and the maker community around them
* Guide business teams through their Power Platform work, from first idea to a solution they can own and maintain themselves
* Help teams make solutions safe and compliant by default, covering environment strategy, DLP, access, agent grounding and data handling, and explain the reasoning behind it
* Contribute to how the CoE itself runs: tooling, monitoring and the platform standards we ask the bank to follow
* Follow where the platform is heading, and translate that into practical guidance for our makers
* Stay up to date with industry trends and emerging technologies to drive innovation in automation development
  


  

**To thrive in this role, we believe you have:**



* Hands\-on experience building and developing solutions with Microsoft Power Platform
* Experience with Copilot Studio or comparable agent tooling
* Some scripting or pro\-code background such as PowerShell, C\# or JavaScript, enough to extend the platform when low\-code runs out
* Automation experience (i.e., RPA, PowerShell, CI/CD or any cloud\-based automation tool, etc.)
* Familiarity with Azure Cloud services
* The ability to teach. You can take someone from confused to confident without taking over their keyboard
* Strong communication skills and comfort working with stakeholders at varying levels of technical fluency
* Excellent problem\-solving skills and attention to detail
* Fluency in English, written and spoken
  


  

**What we offer:**



* Agile and modern ways of working
* A flat hierarchy and openness to share ideas, opinions and points of views
* Extensive training and learning opportunities
* Work\-life balance

It is our fundamental belief that inclusion and diversity is crucial for our future success. We strive to have an inclusive, value\-driven culture where employees feel valued, respected, and involved irrespective of who they are, what they believe or where they come from.

If you have questions about the position, please contact Talent Acquisition Partner Mikaela Ahlstrand at mikaela.ahlstrand@seb.se. Kindly note that we do not accept applications via email.

Customer experience is being transformed by AI\-driven innovation. At Zendesk, we’re not just responding to that shift — we’re leading it. As we expand our AI\-powered Resolution Platform and deepen our Professional Services capabilities, the Technical Architect, AI\-Powered Customer Experience role is critical to helping customers design, implement, and scale intelligent customer service solutions that deliver measurable business value.  

  

  



As a technical expert, solution designer, and trusted advisor, you will help customers translate business goals into scalable AI\-first architectures. You’ll lead discovery, shape solution strategy, remove technical roadblocks, and guide customers toward successful adoption of Zendesk AI capabilities.  

  

  



### **Overarching Objective for the Role**

Accelerate customers’ time\-to\-value by designing and enabling AI\-first Zendesk solutions that drive adoption, automation, and measurable business impact from discovery through scale.


Be the customer’s AI technical architect. Turn business goals into the right architecture, integrations, workflows, and AI design choices.


Lead high\-quality solution discovery and delivery. Run technical discovery sessions, define solution scope, and guide customers through implementation with clarity and confidence.


Remove blockers fast. Anticipate risks, resolve constraints, and keep customer solutions moving toward successful outcomes.

* AI Adoption Enablement: Guide customers through rollout planning, change considerations, and operational readiness to support long\-term AI adoption while leveraging AI tools to enhance individual and team workflows for greater efficiency.

* Customer Advisory: Act as a trusted technical advisor, helping customers make informed decisions about architecture, integrations, data readiness, and implementation tradeoffs.

* Cross\-Functional Collaboration: Work closely with Sales, Customer Success, Support, Product, and Professional Services to align on customer strategy, risks, dependencies, and roadmap considerations.
* Integration \& Extensibility: Identify opportunities to extend Zendesk through APIs, app framework solutions, automation, and custom integrations where needed.
Problem Solving \& Innovation: Diagnose product gaps, technical constraints, or workflow limitations and recommend validated workarounds or design alternatives that preserve business outcomes.  
* 

  

  

### **What You’ll Need to Succeed**

Strategic Skills \& Expertise  



  

* Communication Skills: Excellent verbal and written communication skills with the ability to explain complex AI concepts clearly to both technical and executive audiences in English and German.
* AI\-First Thinking: Strong understanding of how AI capabilities can be applied across the customer service journey to improve efficiency, quality, and experience
* Consultative Technical Leadership: Ability to lead complex customer conversations, build trust quickly, and shape technical direction in ambiguous environments.
* Solution Architecture: Proven ability to design end\-to\-end scalable, maintainable AI architectures
