jobs.title: RPA Solutions Architect
jobs.description:
Ready to utilise your**problem\-solving skills to analyze, create, modify, and support complex systems and operations that enable automated business processes?**  

Are you passionate about **working with a global company where you can future\-proof your career in a supportive and inclusive environment?**  

  

Join us as an **RPA Solution Architect!**  

Contract**: Permanent**  

Location: **Letterkenny (2/3 days in the office)**  

  

**Careers at TCS: It means more.**  

TCS is a purpose\-led transformation company, built on belief. We do not just help businesses to transform through technology. We support them in making a meaningful difference to the people and communities they serve \- our clients include some of the biggest brands in the UK and worldwide. For you, it means more to make an impact that matters, through challenging projects which demand ambitious innovation and thought leadership.* Work closely with the range of teams within the business to bring products to life.
* Gain exposure to innovative technology.
* Shape the future of TCS.

**The Role**
  

As an **Intelligent Automation Solutions Architect** within the Automation Centre of Excellence (CoE), you will be responsible for designing, governing, and delivering enterprise automation solutions that drive operational efficiency and business value. Working closely with business stakeholders, technology teams, and automation developers, you will assess automation opportunities, define scalable solution architectures, and ensure adherence to development standards and best practices.  

  

This role requires deep expertise in the UiPath platform, strong technical leadership, excellent communication skills, and a strategic understanding of the overall automation landscape, including emerging technologies such as Agentic/AI Automation, and enterprise integration capabilities.  

  

**Key Responsibilities:*** Design scalable, secure, and maintainable automation solutions that align with business and technical requirements.
* Participate in requirements gathering sessions and provide technical feasibility assessments and solution recommendations.
* Lead solution design activities and produce supporting technical documentation where required.
* Perform code reviews and solution reviews to ensure quality, consistency, and adherence to development standards.
* Develop and maintain reusable frameworks, libraries, and architectural components.
* Contribute to automation development activities, particularly for complex or enterprise\-wide solutions.
* Collaborate with business stakeholders and technology teams to translate requirements into effective automation solutions.
* Establish and promote development standards, governance frameworks, and best practices across the automation estate.
* Design and implement API\-based integrations between automation solutions and enterprise systems.
* Design, develop, and maintain SQL Server database components, including tables, schemas, stored procedures, and integration frameworks that support automation solutions.
* Mentor and provide technical leadership to developers within the Automation CoE.
* Maintain awareness of industry trends and emerging technologies across RPA, AI, and Intelligent Automation.

**Your Profile**  

**Key Skills/Knowledge/Experiences:*** Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Technology, Engineering, or related discipline, or equivalent industry experience.
* Proficiency with the UiPath platform and enterprise automation solution delivery.
* Demonstrated experience implementing and supporting production solutions using UiPath Document Understanding, Communications Mining, Apps, Integration Service, and other Intelligent Automation capabilities.
* Proven experience designing, developing, and delivering UiPath automation solutions throughout the full project lifecycle, from requirements gathering through production support.
* Experience with UiPath Maestro, Agent Builder, Autopilot, or similar agent orchestration technologies.
* Strong experience designing and implementing API\-based integrations between UiPath automations and enterprise applications.
* Hands\-on experience with Microsoft SQL Server, including database design, schema development, stored procedures, and database integration within automation solutions.
* Experience conducting technical feasibility assessments and defining solution architectures for complex business processes.
* Experience establishing development standards, performing code reviews, and promoting best practices across automation teams.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to engage effectively with both business and technical audiences.
* Strong analytical, problem\-solving, and critical\-thinking abilities.
* Experience mentoring automation developers and providing technical leadership within an Automation Centre of Excellence.
* Ability to evaluate emerging automation technologies and recommend solutions that align with enterprise objectives.

**Good to have:*** Experience within Banking, Financial Services, or other highly regulated environments.
* UiPath Solution Architect, Advanced Developer, or other relevant UiPath certifications.
* Claude Certified Architect, or equivalent AI/LLM architecture certification.
* Experience with Microsoft Copilot Studio, Claude, Codex, Google Gemini, or other enterprise AI platforms.
* Good understanding of Python and C\#/C\+\+/VB for custom integrations, workflow extensions, and automation\-related development.
* Experience with Process Mining, Task Mining, or Process Intelligence solutions.

  

**Rewards \& Benefits**  

TCS is consistently voted as a Top Employer in the UK and globally. Our competitive salary packages feature pension, health care, life assurance, laptop and access to extensive training resources and discounts within the larger Tata network.  

We offer health \& wellness initiatives and sports events; we are the proud sponsor of the London Marathon and partner with our local communities in Ireland.
  

  

**Diversity, Inclusion and Wellbeing**  

Tata Consultancy Services UK\&I is committed to meeting the accessibility needs of all individuals in accordance with the Ireland Employment Equality Acts 1998\-2011 (as amended) and the Equal Status Acts 2000\-2012 (as amended).
  

  

We welcome and embrace diversity in race, nationality, ethnicity, disability, neurodiversity, gender identity, age, physical ability, gender reassignment, sexual orientation. We are a disability inclusive employer and encourage disabled people to apply for this role.
  

As a Disability Confident Employer, we offer an interview to applicants with disabilities or long\-term conditions who meet the minimum criteria for the role. Please email us at **UKI.recruitment@tcs.com** if you would like to opt in.  

  

If you are an applicant who needs any adjustments to the application process or interview, please contact us **at** **UKI.recruitment@tcs.com**with the subject line: “Adjustment Request” or email ***rebecca.mcclelland@tcs.com*** to request an adjustment. We welcome requests prior to you completing the application and at any stage of the recruitment process.
  

  

**Beware of Fraudulent offers**  

This is to notify you that TCS does not ask for any sort of payment or security deposit from candidates at any stage of the recruitment process. The firm never sends out job offers from free internet email services like Gmail, Yahoo Mail, and so on. TCS has not authorised any third\-party company to collect money on their behalf. As a vigilant job seeker, beware of fraudulent recruitment activity and protect your interests! You can write to **UKI.recruitment@tcs.com** to report any fraudulent activity.  

  

Due to the high volume of applications, we will be unable to contact each applicant individually on the status of their application. If you have not received a direct response within 30 days, then it should be deemed unsuccessful on this occasion.  

  

**Join us and do more of what matters. Apply online now.**

Once you have made an application you will not be able to make changes to your selection or make a new application. The exception is if we open new vacancies in the new year.  



**To avoid missing out on your preferred role, we recommend applying** **as early as possible, as positions will close once filled.**

  

**Application process**

  

* Upload CV and cover letter, detailing motivations and suitability for the opportunity.
* Online strengths\-based assessment
  

This opportunity uses a single\-stage strengths\-based interview as part of the selection process.

  

Start your career with a global, employee\-owned consultancy where your work can make a real difference. At Mott MacDonald, you'll work alongside experts, contribute to meaningful projects, and have the support, learning opportunities, and experience needed to grow your career from day one.

  

**Job Description**

  

At Mott MacDonald, we believe every project is an opportunity to improve society. As a wholly employee\-owned business, we're committed to creating outcomes that benefit our clients, communities, and the environment.

  

As a Graduate Mechanical Building Services Engineer, you'll play a key role in designing the systems that make buildings safe, comfortable, efficient, and sustainable. Working alongside multidisciplinary teams, you'll help deliver innovative solutions for some of the world's most complex and high\-profile projects, from healthcare and education facilities to commercial developments, transport hubs, defence infrastructure, and net\-zero developments.

  

This is more than a graduate role. It's an opportunity to develop your technical expertise, work on meaningful projects, and build a rewarding career where your growth and wellbeing are supported from day one.

  

**The Opportunity**

  

Building services engineering is at the heart of creating sustainable, high\-performing buildings. As part of our Building Services team, you'll contribute to the design of mechanical systems that enhance building performance while reducing energy consumption and carbon emissions.

  

You'll gain exposure to all stages of project delivery, from concept and feasibility through to detailed design, construction, commissioning, and operation.

  

**What You'll Do**

  

As a Graduate Mechanical Building Services Engineer, you will:

  

* Support the design and specification of mechanical building services systems, including heating, ventilation, air conditioning (HVAC), domestic water, and public health systems.
* Assist with the preparation of calculations, technical reports, drawings, and specifications.
* Contribute to sustainability and decarbonisation strategies, helping clients achieve net\-zero carbon targets.
* Use industry\-standard software and digital engineering tools to develop and coordinate designs.
* Work collaboratively with electrical, structural, civil, architectural, and sustainability specialists to deliver integrated solutions.
* Participate in site visits, inspections, surveys, and commissioning activities.
* Assist in analysing building energy performance and identifying opportunities for improved efficiency.
* Support project planning, programme management, cost control, and client interactions.
* Develop an understanding of relevant legislation, standards, building regulations, and industry best practice.
  

**Candidate Specification**

  

At Mott MacDonald, we’re looking for curious, motivated graduates who want to make a real difference. Join our purpose\-driven teams where your ideas matter, your growth is supported, and your work enhances the world we live in.


To be eligible for this opportunity, you will have less than 12 months’ relevant experience **(excluding placements**) and have a minimum of a level 7 bachelors degree (obtained no earlier than 2025\) or expected to achieve one of the following degree disciplines:

  

* Mechanical Engineering
* Building Services Engineering
* Architectural Engineering
* Energy Engineering
* Sustainable Building Design
* Building Environment Engineering
* Or a closely related discipline
  

In your application, you should aim to demonstrate your genuine interest in both the opportunity and in joining Mott MacDonald. You can do this by highlighting any relevant experience or interests \- such as modules you've studied, previous work experience, or any research you've undertaken about our company, values, and projects.

  

We personally review every completed application form we receive as this part of our selection process is entirely human led – we do not use AI tools at this stage and kindly ask you not to either. We want you to answer each application question with authenticity so we can get to know the real you. Joining us as a graduate is your opportunity to shape your own story.

  

We are looking for graduates with the following strengths:


* Proactively takes initiative to complete tasks efficiently and independently.
* Communicates effectively and clearly with clients and colleagues.
* Delivers high quality written work with strong attention to detail and clarity.
* Demonstrates a structured and analytical approach to problem solving.
  

**AI Usage**


At Mott MacDonald, we see the value AI can bring, but we take a people\-first approach to hiring. While AI tools can help candidates prepare and build confidence, every application and hiring decision is reviewed by our recruitment and hiring teams. We encourage the responsible use of AI while ensuring we get to know the real person behind the application.

  

**Accessibility**

We want you to feel supported and able to perform at your best throughout our recruitment process. If there is anything we can do to make applying or interviewing with us more accessible, please contact us at **reasonable.adjustments@mottmac.com** and we'll be happy to discuss how we can help.

  

**About your development**


A graduate position should be more than just a job. We know this and so do you. That’s why with our graduate roles we aim to give you the experience and technical knowledge you need to progress your career. From the moment you join us, you’ll receive the training you need. You will be assigned a mentor, who will guide you to meet the objectives of your professional training needs. You will join our three\-year early careers soft skills development programme – Accelerating your Future, which is designed to give you the skills and tools necessary for a long\-lasting successful career here at Mott MacDonald.

  

**Our social side**

  

  

Being part of Mott MacDonald means more than just work; there’s a huge range of fun and exciting things that you can get involved in.


From the moment you join us, you’ll have the opportunity to expand your social and professional network, whether it’s meeting other graduates or joining forces with other members of staff from around the company at our annual sports day. Each of our offices have a sports and social committee which will give you the chance to be part of a variety of sports, social and charity events. We’re committed to promoting a strong culture of social responsibility and encourage our staff to play active roles in the local community.


It's worth noting that sports and social committees tend to vary from office to office, so as well as getting involved in what’s already on offer, don’t be afraid to suggest new events or initiatives that you think could be a great addition. It doesn’t stop there. From your first day, you’ll have access to Perks at Work, giving you discounts on cinema tickets, travel, utilities and much more, helping you make the most of our employee benefits.

  

**Agile working**

At Mott MacDonald, we believe it makes business sense for you and your manager to choose how you can work most effectively to meet your client, team, and personal commitments. We offer a hybrid working policy that embraces your well\-being, flexibility, and trust.

  

**Equality, diversity, and inclusion**


We put equality, diversity, and inclusion at the heart of our business, seeking to promote fair employment procedures and practices to ensure equal opportunities for all. We encourage individual expression in our workplace and are committed to creating an inclusive environment where **everyone** feels they can contribute.

  

**We offer some fantastic benefits including:**

  

* **Biannual salary reviews:** We believe hard work should be recognised and rewarded. To support your development and progression, you'll be eligible for salary reviews twice a year during your first three years with us, subject to successfully completing your probation period.
* Flexible working
* Pension matched up to 7% of base salary

* An annual professional institution subscription
* Life insurance
* Income continuance
* Enhanced Paternity leave
* Annual company performance bonus scheme – Subject to company performance
* Cycle to work scheme
* Travel TaxSaver tickets
* Commitment to Continuing Professional Development – we are accredited by Engineers Ireland
* A broad range of opportunities to enhance both technical and soft skills through mentoring, formal training, and self\-development options.
  

**Networks, communities, and social outcomes**


* Join a wide range of groups including our Advanced Employee Networks which support our LGBTQ\+, gender, race and ethnicity, disability, and parents/carers communities.
* Make a difference within our communities through our social outcomes.

jobs.title: Senior Software Development Engineer, Transactional Data Storage
jobs.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------


Do you want to work deep inside a database that processes billions of transactions every day across Amazon's consumer and digital businesses? Our team builds the data platforms at the core of Amazon, storing customer orders, catalog and product information, shopping carts, device data, and hundreds of other business\-critical datasets. The performance and availability of our platform is critical to the reliability of the Amazon brand, and we run some of the largest fleets and highest\-throughput services at the company.  

  

We are looking for a Senior Software Development Engineer who understands distributed systems at scale and wants to shape the shared storage layer of our next\-generation online transaction processing (OLTP) database. You will design how committed transactions are materialized to cloud object storage, how space is reclaimed as data is superseded, and how data nodes read back through a storage\-format\-agnostic contract. You will partner with Amazon Web Services (AWS) to leverage cloud\-native technologies and contribute innovations back to the broader market. If you thrive on solving ambiguous, high\-impact problems from design to delivery, we would love to hear from you.  

  

Key job responsibilities  

* Design, develop, and operate the distributed shared storage layer that holds the durable copy of every committed write for Amazon's mission\-critical OLTP database platform.
* Collaborate with Principal Engineers and peers to define technical solutions for complex problems such as storage engine design, durability and consistency protocols, read\-path caching, and backpressure under load.
* Own end\-to\-end delivery of features, from writing design documents and implementing production\-quality code to driving operational readiness and deployment.
* Mentor engineers through design and code reviews, pairing on hard problems, and helping them take on larger pieces of the system while raising the team's quality bar.
* Build monitoring, alarming, and automation that keep our high\-throughput services reliable, and participate in on\-call rotations to troubleshoot issues and drive root\-cause resolution.

  

A day in the life  

You will split your time between deep individual work like writing code, reviewing designs, and prototyping storage\-layer changes, and collaborative sessions with your team and partner teams. Expect regular design reviews where you debate trade\-offs around durability, latency, and cost, along with weekly operational reviews that keep the platform healthy. Some weeks you will be heads\-down implementing a new compaction strategy; other weeks you will pair with a teammate to debug a subtle consistency issue in production.  

  

About the team  

Our team sits within the Transact organization and is responsible for the storage engine layer that underpins Amazon's OLTP platform that powers all Amazon Stores. We are a group of engineers who care deeply about correctness, performance, and operational rigor. We partner closely with AWS service teams, sharing innovations in both directions. Our focus over the coming years is scaling the next\-generation storage layer to meet Amazon's growing transaction volume while improving efficiency and reducing costs, and we are looking for engineers who want to help shape that future.**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* Bachelor's degree
* Experience in professional, non\-internship software development
* Experience in development in the last 3 years
* Experience programming with at least one modern language such as Java, C\+\+, or C\# including object\-oriented design
* Experience leading the architecture and design (architecture, design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and current systems

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* Experience with full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations
* Experience in debugging, profiling, and implementing software engineering best practices in large\-scale systems
* Knowledge of databases, storage and big data concepts
* Experience with performance and scalability testing

  

Amazon is an equal opportunities employer. We believe passionately that employing a diverse workforce is central to our success. We make recruiting decisions based on your experience and skills. We value your passion to discover, invent, simplify and build. Protecting your privacy and the security of your data is a longstanding top priority for Amazon. Please consult our Privacy Notice (https://www.amazon.jobs/en/privacy\_page) to know more about how we collect, use and transfer the personal data of our candidates.  

  

Amazon is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of protected veteran status, disability, or other legally protected status.  

  

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how\-we\-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

jobs.title: Senior Data Engineer
jobs.description:
Hos Blue Water Shipping er data og teknologi en central del af vores fremtidige udvikling. Vi er godt i gang med at bygge en moderne dataplatform i Microsoft Fabric, der skal understøtte en global forretning med stærke, skaler\-bare og værdiskabende løsninger. Efterspørgslen fra forretningen er stor, opbakningen fra øverste ledelse er tyde\-lig, og vores Data Platform \& Analytics\-team er vokset markant. Derfor søger vi nu endnu en Senior Data Engineer med stærk data engineering\-erfaring, som vil være med til at videreudvikle og udbrede vores dataplatform.


#### **Byg videre på en moderne dataplatform**


Du bliver en del af vores Data Platform \& Analytics\-team, hvor vi arbejder tæt sammen med forretningen om at ud\-vikle løsninger, der gør data mere tilgængelige, pålidelige og anvendelige på tværs af organisationen. Rollen har et tydeligt teknisk omdrejningspunkt, og du får mulighed for at påvirke arkitektur, datamodeller og måden, vi bygger, driver og udbreder vores dataplatform på.


Som Senior Data Engineer får du en central rolle i den fortsatte udvikling af vores dataplatform. Du vil både arbejde hands\-on med klassiske data engineering\-opgaver og være med til at sikre, at platformen kan understøtte nye te\-ams, applikationer og andre data consumers.


Dine vigtigste opgaver bliver blandt andet at:


* Designe tekniske løsninger, der er skalerbare, robuste og kan genbruges på tværs af organisationen
* Være med til at udvikle og udbrede platformens anvendelse til nye teams, applikationer og andre data con\-sumers
* Samarbejde tæt med forretningen og andre udviklingsteams om at omsætte behov til værdiskabende data\-løsninger
* Integrere nye datakilder på vores dataplatform
* Udvikle nye datamodeller

**Sæt dit præg med stærk backend\-erfaring og moderne data engineering**


Vi forestiller os, at du har solid erfaring med data engineering og moderne dataplatforme. Du har en stærk teknisk værktøjskasse og kan selvstændigt tage ansvar for en opgave fra problemstilling til færdig løsning.


Du har erfaring med at arbejde på en data platform, hvor data anvendes af flere forskellige consumers, og du for\-står, hvordan tekniske løsninger kan designes, så de skaber værdi ud over den enkelte leverance.


Derudover ser vi gerne, at du har erfaring med flere af følgende områder:


* Stærke kompetencer inden for SQL og Python
* Erfaring med datamodellering, transformation og integration af nye datakilder
* Erfaring med moderne data platforme og forståelse for platform architecture
* Erfaring med at udvikle løsninger, som anvendes af andre teams, applikationer eller analytikere
* Erfaring med teknologier som Microsoft Fabric, Databricks eller tilsvarende er en fordel

Som person er du nysgerrig, struktureret og løsningsorienteret. Du kan arbejde selvstændigt med tekniske pro\-blemstillinger, men motiveres også af at skabe løsninger sammen med andre. Du kan kommunikere komplekse tekniske problemstillinger på en måde, der skaber forståelse og fremdrift og du forstår, at vores vigtigste opgave er at skabe løsninger, der understøtter og skaber værdi for forretningen.


#### **Vi tilbyder**


Hos Blue Water Shipping tror vi på kontinuerlig forbedring og stræber efter at opbygge en kultur, der værdsætter innovation og forandring \- baseret på data som grundlag. Vores virksomhedskultur er præget af iværksætterånd, stort fokus på medarbejdernes trivsel og tillid.


Vi tilbyder en fleksibel arbejdsdag og opgaver, du selv kan sætte dit præg på. Du kan arbejde fra vores hovedkon\-tor i Esbjerg, Taulov eller Aarhus og kombinere det med 1\-2 dage om ugen i Esbjerg.


#### **Yderligere oplysninger**


Hvis du har spørgsmål til stillingen, eller mangler yderligere oplysninger, er du meget velkommen til at kontakte Global Manager, Jesper Ravnborg Nissen på tlf. \+45 3124 9420\.


Vi afholder samtaler løbende og ansætter, når den rette kandidat er fundet.


#### **Together we create solutions**

Vores værdigrundlag lever i dag i bedste velgående og er drevet af en udpræget entreprenørånd og godt købmandskab. jobs.title: Senior IT Process Engineer (POMS MES)
jobs.description:
Category: Digital \& IT
Location:
Måløv, Capital Region of Denmark, DK  

*Are you passionate about developing digital solutions that enable the delivery of clinical supplies to patients around the world? Do you thrive in a role where software development, manufacturing systems and business processes come together? If so, you could be our new Senior IT Process Engineer in Clinical Supplies Digital Solution.*

  

**Your new role**

  

As Senior IT Process Engineer, you will play a key role in the development, optimisation, and support of **POMS**, a business\-critical Manufacturing Execution System (MES) supporting Clinical Supplies packaging and shipping processes.


Working closely with business stakeholders, IT colleagues, and external partners, you will drive the continuous improvement of POMS and related business processes, ensuring the solution remains reliable, compliant, and fit for future growth. Over time, you may also contribute to the wider digital landscape, including technologies such as Databricks, helping to strengthen the digital capabilities that support the global Clinical Supplies supply chain.

  

Your key responsibilities will include:


* Designing, building, testing, and supporting .NET/C\# applications, APIs, interfaces, background services, and custom MES functionality.
* Developing and maintaining SQL databases, data models, stored procedures, and integrations that support business\-critical processes.
* Driving optimisation and continuous improvement of POMS and related Clinical Supplies processes.
* Translating business requirements into robust, scalable, and compliant technical solutions.
* Collaborating with stakeholders across Clinical Supplies, Quality, Validation, and IT to ensure alignment between business needs and system capabilities.
* Coordinating development activities delivered by external suppliers and ensuring successful implementation of new functionality.
* Supporting testing, validation, releases, change management, and system improvements in accordance with GMP/GxP requirements.
* Acting as a technical problem solver and driving resolution of complex incidents and operational challenges.
  

You will have significant ownership of your area and the opportunity to influence the future digital landscape supporting Clinical Supplies.

  

**Your new department**

  

You will join **CS Digital Solution**, a team responsible for developing, maintaining, and supporting digital solutions used throughout Clinical Supplies.

  

We work closely with colleagues across Line of Business, Quality, Validation, and IT to deliver reliable, compliant, and innovative solutions that support the supply of clinical products globally. The team combines strong technical expertise with deep business understanding and has a clear focus on continuous improvement, collaboration, and delivering value to patients through digital innovation.

  

You will become part of an ambitious and supportive environment where knowledge sharing, professional development, and teamwork are key elements of how we work together.

  

**Your skills and qualifications**

  

To succeed in this role, we imagine that you have:


* A Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, IT, Engineering, or a related discipline.
* At least 5 years of professional .NET/C\# development experience.
* 5\-10 years of hands\-on SQL development experience, including database design, complex queries, and performance optimisation.
* Experience working in GMP\- or GxP\-regulated environments.
* Strong understanding of computer system validation, data integrity, and quality processes.
* Experience developing enterprise\-level applications, interfaces, integrations, APIs, schedulers, or similar technical solutions.
* Hands\-on experience with Manufacturing Execution Systems (MES) is required. Experience with POMS, PAS\-X, or comparable MES platforms is considered essential for success in this role.
  

In addition, we are looking for someone who:


* Has strong analytical and problem\-solving skills.
* Can work independently while navigating a complex stakeholder landscape.
* Communicates effectively with both technical and non\-technical audiences.
* Enjoys collaborating across functions and building strong working relationships.
* Is fluent in English, written and spoken.
  

Experience from the pharmaceutical industry and familiarity with Clinical Supplies processes would be considered an advantage.

  

**Working at Novo Nordisk**

  

At Novo Nordisk, we don't wait for change. We drive it. Every day, our employees work to improve the lives of millions of people living with serious chronic diseases.


We believe that success comes from diverse perspectives, curiosity, and a willingness to challenge the status quo. That's why we create an environment where talented people can grow, collaborate, and make a meaningful difference.

  

When you join Novo Nordisk, you become part of a company with a strong purpose, ambitious goals, and opportunities for both professional and personal development.

  

**What we offer**

  

Salary: For this role, the Annual Base Salary ranges from 651,000 to 956,900 DKK, corresponding to the level of the position.
  

The placement within the salary range will be assessed during the recruitment process based on the candidate’s skills, competencies, knowledge, and relevant experience.

  

Incentives and Benefits: The salary package may include short\-term and/or long\-term incentives as well as other employee benefits based on position level, location, functional area and relevant market benchmarks.


Learn more about our Reward Philosophy here

  

There is, of course, more on offer here than the uniqueness of our culture and the extraordinary results we produce. Being part of a global healthcare company means opportunities to learn and develop are all around us, while our benefits are designed with your career and life stage in mind.

  

**Deadline**

  

27 September 2026\.


Applications will be reviewed on an ongoing basis, and we encourage candidates to apply as soon as possible.

Senior Mechanical Design Engineer (Sequencing Instrument Platform)  



  

**Position Summary**

The Senior Mechanical Design Engineer in Illumina’s R\&D department will lead and contribute to the development of new, industry\-leading genetic analysis platforms for life sciences and clinical markets. The engineer will be responsible for design of DNA sequencing equipment that includes complex optical, mechanical, electrical, chemical, and software sub\-systems. The engineer will be responsible for participating in and coordinating cross\-functional teams, developing plans, performing analysis, and innovating new technologies.  



  

**Job duties and responsibilities include:**

* Uncover product requirements and translate requirements into subsystem specifications.
* Design precision electro\-mechanical and fluidic mechanisms.
* Work in concurrent, cross\-functional teams.
* Actively seek out and collect input from stakeholders across supporting disciplines.
* Manage outsourced design and manufacturing relationships.
* Compare performance and cost of design options in a data driven manner.
* Perform mechanical and thermal analysis of subsystem / system designs.
* Create schedules and manage actions to meet milestones.
* Perform risk analysis, develop test plans, and execute verification testing of subsystems and systems.
* Follow through on transfer of new products into manufacturing, track issues in manufacturing and the field, and implement resolution of issues.
* Propose and investigate new architecture, technologies and products that enable the goals of Illumina’s product portfolio.
* Candidates must thrive in a dynamic environment and place great emphasis on meeting milestones and breaking down barriers to achieve results.
* Candidate would be required to travel to US for work purposes

All listed tasks and responsibilities are deemed as essential functions to this position; however, business conditions may require reasonable accommodation for additional tasks and responsibilities.  



  

**Preferred:**

* Experience in biomedical instruments, biological assays, and/or genetic analysis equipment is preferred.
Experience in FDA regulated markets is a plus.  
* 

  

**Education and experience:**

* BS/MS/PhD in Mechanical Engineering, Physics, or related and \>5 years industry experience.
* Candidate must have experience in product development, transfer to manufacturing, and documentation.
* Candidate must have a proven track record in designing robust electro\-mechanical systems which may include imaging, dynamic motion control, fluidics components, and thermal control.
* Demonstrated knowledge of mechanical engineering design principles and practices \- Form, fit, tolerance stack analysis, GD\&T, drafting standards, FEA, design for assembly, design for manufacturing, etc.
* Experience with a wide variety of manufacturing processes (low, medium, and high volume).
* Selection of electromechanical components such as motors, power transmission components and sensors.
* Evaluation and optimization of complex tolerance budgets.
* Candidate must have strong project management skills and interpersonal, relationship\-building skills.
* Fluent in SolidWorks CAD software and one or more mechanical FEA packages.

All listed requirements are deemed essential functions to this position; however, business conditions may require reasonable accommodation for additional tasks and responsibilities.  



  

**ATTITUDE/ATTRIBUTES:**

* Ability and willingness to make an impact
* Creativity of thought and mindset
* Thrives in a dynamic and fast paced environment
A passion for discovery

jobs.title: Technical Operations Engineer
jobs.description:
**The Role**
------------



The Technical Operations Engineer is responsible for maintaining operational excellence across systems, processes, and technology platforms. This role focuses on incident management, operational monitoring, process optimization, stakeholder support, and continuous improvement to ensure reliable business and customer operations.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------



Operations Management

* Be on rotation for availability incidents and provide support for customer service engineers.
* Proactively develop scripts and tools to prevent incidents from ever happening.
* Monitor and maintain daily operational performance of systems and services.
* Ensure timely resolution of operational issues and service disruptions.
* Manage operational workflows and process adherence.

  

Incident \& Escalation Management

* Investigate, troubleshoot, and resolve technical issues.
* Coordinate cross\-functional teams during incidents and escalations.
* Conduct root cause analysis and implement preventive actions.

  

Process Improvement

* Identify inefficiencies and recommend automation opportunities.
* Create and maintain Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs).
* Drive operational excellence initiatives and continuous improvement projects.

  

Data Analysis \& Reporting

* Monitor and report on operational KPIs and service metrics.
* Analyze trends, risks, and performance gaps.
* Prepare dashboards and management reports.

  

Stakeholder Collaboration

* Partner with Engineering, Product, Customer Support, and Business Operations teams.
* Provide operational guidance and technical support to stakeholders.
* Communicate status updates and recommendations effectively.

  

Compliance \& Risk Management

* Ensure compliance with operational policies and security standards.
* Identify operational risks and develop mitigation plans.
* Support audit and governance activities as required.
**Requirements**
----------------


* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or related field.
* 5\+ years of experience in Technical Operations, IT Operations, System Support, Data Operations, or a related role.
* Strong troubleshooting and analytical skills.
* Experience with ticketing systems and monitoring tools.
* Proficiency in SQL, Excel, or data analysis tools.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
* Strong programming skills, Net, Java, Python, JavaScript, etc.
* Strong experience with Monitoring tools: Datadog, Prometheus, Grafana, Cloudwatch, ELK, etc.
* Experience with cloud platforms (Azure, AWS, or GCP).
* Knowledge of scripting or automation tools (Python, PowerShell, Shell Scripting).
* Familiarity with ITIL, Agile, or DevOps methodologies.
* Experience supporting large\-scale production environments.

jobs.description:

For over 55 years ASM has been ahead of what's next, at the forefront of innovation and what's technologically possible. Our development programs help support your growth, shaping your future and pushing the boundaries of innovation to unleash potential.


**Job's mission**



As a Senior Test Engineer, you'll play a critical role in turning breakthrough designs into real\-world manufacturing solutions. From concept to customer delivery, you'll drive new product industrialization by working cross\-functionally to optimize for quality, cost, and lead time. You'll be a strategic partner to both Global Operations and our Business Units, influencing design, improving processes, and supporting the full product lifecycle.

  


**What you will be working on**


* Design and develop cost\-effective testing methods with innovations on automation for systems and equipment testing throughout product development and manufacturing in meeting efficiency and customer quality requirements.
* Provide holistic technical solutions and drive standardization of testing methodology to produce consistent testing quality outcome in addressing testing needs across supplier, contract manufacturing, and internal manufacturing by liaising with cross functional teams in GOPS and Business Units (BU).
* Prepare test and diagnostic programs according to product requirements, refine detailed test specifications, develop detailed procedures, including assisting with the definition of test specifications with design / software engineering.
* Develop hardware and software for test fixtures, plan and coordinate test fixture sourcing activities as needed, debug and deploy test fixtures for production.
* Gathers operational and test data to evaluate test results; may take corrective/continuous improvement actions.
* Work with internal and external stakeholders to influence decisions and drive product testing improvements.

  


**What we are looking for**


* Bachelor's degree in electrical/electronic engineering, automation engineering or equivalent.
* Minimum 8 years of experience in a manufacturing or engineering environment, ideally 5 years in semiconductor capital equipment industry.
* Experience in testing optimization, including test case/option addition, automation and standardization initiatives
* Experience with control systems utilized in testing automation, serial communication protocols, TwinCAT PLC, DeviceNet, EtherCAT, RS 485, RS 232, etc.
* Working knowledge of testing methodology as well as programming languages such as C\#, Python, etc.
* Proven track record of managing technical projects to completion while accomplishing objectives and influencing cross\-functional teams
* Proficient in operational excellence tools such as FMEA, 8D, SPC and Six Sigma

  


**What sets you apart**


* Strong cross\-functional communication, stakeholder engagement, presentation and organization skills
* Experience in test automation for equipment product and IoT devices integration
* Exposure to manufacturing digitization and data\-driven process improvement

**Apply today to be part of what's next.**



We make the tech that enables the chips in devices which improve lives around the world. We do this with an eye to the future, pushing the boundaries of what's possible through cutting\-edge innovation, and driving the next wave of technological breakthroughs that shape how we live, work, and connect.



To learn more about ASM, find us at asm.com and on LinkedIn, Facebook, Instagram, X and YouTube.

jobs.title: 2027 Software Dev Engineer Intern - Iași, Romania
jobs.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------


Do you want to solve real customer problems through innovative technology? Do you enjoy working on scalable services in a collaborative team environment? Do you want to see your code directly impact millions of customers worldwide?
  

  

At Amazon, we hire the best minds in technology to innovate and build on behalf of our customers. Customer obsession is part of our company DNA, which has made us one of the world's most beloved brands.
  

  

Our Software Development Engineer (SDE) interns use modern technology to solve complex problems while seeing their work's impact first\-hand. The challenges SDE interns solve at Amazon are meaningful and influence millions of customers, sellers, and products globally. We seek individuals passionate about creating new products, features, and services while managing ambiguity in an environment where development cycles are measured in weeks, not years.
  

  

At Amazon, we believe in ownership at every level. As an SDE intern, you'll own the entire lifecycle of your code \- from design through deployment and ongoing operations. This ownership mindset, combined with our commitment to operational excellence, ensures we deliver the highest quality solutions for our customers.
  

  

We're looking for curious minds who think big and want to define tomorrow's technology. At Amazon, you'll grow into the high\-impact engineer you know you can be, supported by a culture of learning and mentorship. Every day brings exciting new challenges and opportunities for personal growth.
  

  

Amazon internships across all seasons are full\-time positions, and interns should expect to work in office, Monday\-Friday, up to 40 hours per week typically between 8am\-5pm. Specific team norms around working hours will be communicated by your manager. Interns should not have conflicts such as classes or other employment during the Amazon work\-day. Applicants should have a minimum of one quarter/semester/trimester remaining in their studies after their internship concludes.
  

  

Key job responsibilities  

Collaborate and communicate effectively with experienced cross\-disciplinary Amazonians to design, build, and operate innovative products and services that delight our customers, while participating in technical discussions to drive solutions forward.
  

  

Break down complex, ambiguous problems into well\-defined, solvable components before implementation.
  

  

Contribute to the design and development of scalable, reliable services, with distributed\-systems scope varying by team.
  

  

Participate in code reviews as a core engineering practice, providing constructive feedback and validating correctness.
  

  

Contribute to clear and accurate technical documentation.
  

  

Use GenAI and AI\-powered tools to enhance development productivity, and critically validate, verify, and integrate AI\-generated code, exercising sound judgement about when to trust AI output.
  

  

Write clean, maintainable code following best practices and design patterns.
  

  

Work in an agile environment practicing CI/CD principles while participating in operational responsibilities including on\-call duties.
  

  

Demonstrate operational excellence through monitoring, troubleshooting, and resolving production issues.
  

  

A day in the life  

As an intern, you will be matched to a manager and a mentor and will have the opportunity to influence the evolution of Amazon technology and lead critical projects early in your career.
  

  

In addition to working on an impactful project, you will have the opportunity to engage with Amazonians for both personal and professional development, expand your network, and participate in activities with other interns throughout your internship. No matter the location of your internship, we give you the tools to own your project and learn in a real\-world setting.
  

  

About the team  

Intern Community:
  

  

As an Amazon Intern, you'll be part of a vibrant, supportive community that empowers your growth and development. You'll collaborate with interns from around the world, networking and participating in social events to broaden your perspectives. You can also join specialized groups focused on areas like sustainability to explore your diverse interests.
  

  

Support:
  

  

The internship program provides a robust support system, including weekly intern office hours, dedicated IT and HR support, and a program team committed to your success. This ensures you have the guidance and assistance needed to thrive.
  

  

Learning Sessions:
  

  

Exclusive learning sessions will further enhance your skills, granting you access to Amazon's cutting\-edge learning platforms and the expertise of industry leaders. These structured development opportunities will prepare you for the next step in your career.
  

  

Opportunities:
  

  

Upon successful completion of the internship, you may be considered for a graduate role or a second internship, allowing you to continue your journey with Amazon. Additionally, you'll enjoy a competitive monthly salary, relocation support, and access to a range of employee benefits.


**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* Are enrolled in a Bachelor's degree or above in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or related fields at time of application
* Knowledge of computer science fundamentals such as object\-oriented design, operating systems, algorithms, data structures, and complexity analysis
* Experience with at least one general\-purpose programming language such as Java, Python, C\+\+, C\#, Go, Rust, or TypeScript

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* Experience from a technical internship
* Experience with distributed, multi\-tiered systems, algorithms, and relational databases
* Experience with Cloud platforms (preferably AWS), database systems (SQL and NoSQL), AI tools for development productivity, contributing to open\-source projects, and/or version control systems
* Experience using AI\-assisted development tools in academic or professional settings
* Ability to effectively articulate technical challenges and solutions
* Adept at handling ambiguous or undefined problems as well as ability to think abstractly
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills

  

Amazon is an equal opportunities employer. We believe passionately that employing a diverse workforce is central to our success. We make recruiting decisions based on your experience and skills. We value your passion to discover, invent, simplify and build. Protecting your privacy and the security of your data is a longstanding top priority for Amazon. Please consult our Privacy Notice (https://www.amazon.jobs/en/privacy\_page) to know more about how we collect, use and transfer the personal data of our candidates.  

  

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how\-we\-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

You will play a key role in supporting, optimizing and continuously enhancing our core business systems and ERP applications. Acting as a vital link between technology, business operations, end\-users and external vendors, you will translate business needs into effective digital solutions, oversee system improvements and contribute to the successful delivery of transformation initiatives.

  

The position reports directly to the **Digital Transformation Manager**.

 **Key Responsibilities**


* Analyze, support and enhance core business systems and enterprise applications, including ERP systems, ensuring alignment with operational workflows and business requirements.
* Design and develop tailored in\-house applications or custom scripts, as required, to address specific business needs.
* Act as the primary liaison between internal end\-users and external software vendors, facilitating effective communication and accelerating issue resolution.
* Oversee system installations, upgrades and configurations carried out by external vendors, ensuring timely, efficient and high\-quality project delivery.
* Design and execute comprehensive end\-to\-end testing and User Acceptance Testing (UAT) to ensure system reliability and seamless performance.
* Deliver engaging training sessions and develop clear user documentation to support end\-users and promote the successful adoption of new technologies.
* Develop and deliver a wide range of reports, dashboards and data insights, supporting business continuity and providing Top Management with valuable information for decision\-making.

  


**Required Qualifications**


* Education: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering or a closely related field.
* Experience: At least two years of relevant professional experience in application support, business analysis, ERP implementation or a related field.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills in Greek and English (a third language will be considered an asset).

  


**Skills**


* Strong hands\-on knowledge of relational database management systems, with particular emphasis on Microsoft SQL Server and T\-SQL.
* Familiarity with at least one major programming language, such as Python, C\#, Java, PHP or VB.
* Excellent analytical and problem\-solving skills, with the ability to prioritize tasks and manage multiple responsibilities effectively in a fast\-paced environment.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills in both Greek and English, including the ability to explain technical concepts clearly to non\-technical audiences.
* A proactive and collaborative team player who can also work independently, quickly adapt to emerging technologies and demonstrate a strong commitment to continuous improvement.
* Experience with Business Intelligence tools, such as Power BI or QlikView, and the ability to transform raw data into meaningful and actionable dashboards will be considered an asset.
* Familiarity with Robotic Process Automation (RPA) and workflow automation tools, such as Power Automate or UiPath, will be considered an asset.

  



We are an Equal Opportunity Employer and are committed to ensuring that our employment practices do not discriminate based on race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, national origin, age, marital status, medical condition, disability, or any other legally protected status. By applying, you agree to the Consent Form for the Processing of Personal Data(GDPR). More information can be found at: https://www.neptunelines.com/consent\-form\-processing\-personal\-data

  

In accordance with the EU Pay Transparency Directive (EU) 2023/970, compensation details for this position will be communicated to candidates by our HR team at an appropriate stage prior to the interview process.

jobs.title: Customer Support Engineer
jobs.description:
**Summary**  

  

We are looking to hire a Customer Support Engineer as a part of Telesign Technical Support who will be working with our customers as well as with internal teams on troubleshooting issues, resolving them, or escalating problems. * Strong ability to prioritize and multi\-task in a fast\-paced environment.
* Attention to detail.

**We are offering*** Good compensation \- Competitive € salary plus benefits package.

Proximus Global, combining the strengths of Telesign, BICS, and Route Mobile, is transforming the future of communications and digital identity. jobs.title: Développeur Fullstack (H/F)
jobs.description:
**Localité :** Genève
**Type de contrat :** CDI
Digital Solutions SA recrute un **Développeur Fullstack (H/F)** en CDI à 100 % dans le **canton de Genève**. Au sein d’une équipe agile, vous concevez, développez et déployez des applications web performantes et scalables, du back\-end (Node.js, Java, Python ou .NET) jusqu’à l’interface utilisateur (Angular, React ou Vue.js).


**Le poste en bref**
--------------------


* **Poste :** Développeur Fullstack (H/F)
* **Employeur :** Digital Solutions SA, intégrateur et prestataire de services IT suisse
* **Lieu :** canton de Genève, Suisse
* **Type de contrat :** CDI
* **Taux d’occupation :** 100 %
* **Expérience :** 3 ans minimum en tant que développeur Fullstack au sein d’une équipe agile
* **Formation :** diplôme universitaire ou d’école d’ingénieur, ou formation équivalente
* **Technologies :** Node.js, Java, Python ou .NET ; Angular, React ou Vue.js ; API RESTful, bases de données, Git, intégration continue
* **Langues :** français (excellente maîtrise), anglais (niveau B2 minimum)
* **Date de publication :** 21 septembre 2026

**Vos missions**
----------------


Au sein d’une équipe de développement, vos missions seront les suivantes :


* Concevoir, développer et déployer des applications web performantes et scalables, de la couche back\-end jusqu’à l’interface utilisateur front\-end ;
* Collaborer avec les équipes métiers et les chefs de projet pour analyser les besoins, rédiger les spécifications techniques et concevoir des solutions ergonomiques ;
* Garantir la qualité logicielle par l’écriture de tests automatisés, des revues de code rigoureuses et le respect des bonnes pratiques de développement ;
* Assurer l’intégration continue, le suivi des versions et l’optimisation des performances des applications, existantes comme nouvelles ;
* Participer activement à la résolution de problématiques techniques complexes et assurer un support de niveau avancé sur les applications.

Ce poste s’inscrit dans notre domaine d’expertise « Développement logiciel ».


**Votre profil**
----------------


### **Formation**


Vous êtes titulaire d’un diplôme d’études universitaires ou d’une formation supérieure en école d’ingénieur (ou d’une formation équivalente).


### **Expérience et compétences techniques**


* Au moins 3 ans d’expérience en tant que développeur Fullstack au sein d’une équipe agile ;
* Maîtrise de plusieurs langages et frameworks modernes, côté back\-end (par exemple Node.js, Java, Python ou .NET) comme côté front\-end (par exemple Angular, React ou Vue.js) ;
* Solides compétences en gestion de bases de données et en conception d’API RESTful ;
* Habitude des outils de versioning et d’intégration continue (Git).

### **Qualités personnelles**


Rigoureux, doté d’un fort esprit d’équipe et d’une excellente capacité d’analyse, vous êtes orienté qualité. Curieux d’appréhender de nouveaux environnements métiers et techniques, vous faites preuve d’autonomie et de polyvalence dans la conduite de vos projets.


### **Langues**


* Français : excellente maîtrise
* Anglais : pratique courante (niveau B2 minimum)

**Qui est Digital Solutions SA ?**
----------------------------------


Fondée en 2016 à Porrentruy, au cœur du Jura, Digital Solutions SA est un intégrateur et prestataire de services IT suisse. Nous aidons les entreprises et les institutions à relever leurs défis numériques grâce à l’intégration de nouvelles technologies, et les accompagnons dans leur stratégie d’innovation comme dans le développement de leurs nouveaux produits numériques.


Implantés à Porrentruy, Bâle, Lausanne, Genève et Martigny, et bientôt à Fribourg, Berne, Zurich et Delémont, nous combinons agilité, innovation et performance pour mettre à la disposition de nos clients des équipes d’ingénieurs hautement qualifiés, adaptées à leurs besoins. Nos quatre domaines d’expertise :


* l’intelligence artificielle ;
* l’intégration et l’innovation ;
* le développement logiciel ;
* la Robotic Process Automation (RPA).

Pour en savoir plus, découvrez pourquoi nous rejoindre et qui nous sommes.


**Questions fréquentes sur ce poste**
-------------------------------------


### **Où se situe le poste de Développeur Fullstack ?**


Le poste est basé dans le canton de Genève, en Suisse. Digital Solutions SA y dispose d’un bureau à Sécheron (chemin des Mines 2, 1202 Genève).


### **Quel type de contrat est proposé ?**


Il s’agit d’un contrat à durée indéterminée (CDI), avec un taux d’occupation de 100 %.


### **Quel profil recherchons\-nous ?**


Nous recherchons un développeur Fullstack justifiant d’au moins 3 ans d’expérience en équipe agile, à l’aise aussi bien côté back\-end que front\-end, titulaire d’un diplôme universitaire ou d’école d’ingénieur (ou équivalent).


### **Quelles technologies sont utilisées ?**


Côté back\-end : Node.js, Java, Python ou .NET ; côté front\-end : Angular, React ou Vue.js. Le poste implique également la conception d’API RESTful, la gestion de bases de données et l’utilisation de Git et de l’intégration continue.


### **Comment postuler ?**


Remplissez le formulaire « Postulez ! » situé en bas de cette page en joignant votre CV et, si vous le souhaitez, vos autres documents (lettre de motivation, diplômes, certificats de travail). Vous pouvez également consulter toutes nos offres d’emploi en Suisse.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer Fullstack (f/m/d)
jobs.description:
Valora digital is the tech unit of Valora. We are a team of developers and product managers that tackle projects that delight customers, improve processes and keep the company ready for the future of retail. We develop modern, web\-based E\-commerce solutions such as customer\-facing self\-checkout devices, backoffice tools for monitoring and management of those devices, employee\-facing applications to facilitate their hard foodvenience work in kitchens, and mobile apps to accelerate our internal processes at Valora. Many of our projects are in production use today and we own our code and our infrastructure end\-to\-end.  

  

**Who we are looking for**  

We are seeking a skilled and curious software engineer with a track record of delivering value. To you, software engineering is about maintainability, paradigms, and algorithms rather than languages, frameworks, or platforms. As engineers, we proactively interface with business to make sure we’re continuously solving real problems.  

  

  

**Key tasks and responsibilities**  

  

* Help shape the future of our shopping experience
* Write clean, efficient, and reusable code and conduct code reviews
* Troubleshoot and debug issues reported by customers and internal stakeholders
* Document technical specifications, processes, and guidelines
* Design and implement visually appealing and user\-friendly interfaces
* Contribute to the continuous improvement of development processes and workflows

  

  

**Key skills / requirements**  

  

* 5\+ years of professional experience in software development
* You like to use your expertise to sketch and implement tasks end\-to\-end, from the user\-facing frontend all the way to defining the PostgreSQL database model
* You take ownership of the things you work on and you’re able to operate autonomously, but without isolating yourself from the rest of the team
* CI/CD is second nature to you and you think deployments should be frequent, fast, painless, zero\-downtime, and easy to roll back
* The core technologies we use include F\# (.NET), Typescript \+ React, PostgreSQL, GCP \+ Azure, Terraform, Swift, and even Nix flakes. There's more if you dig deeper.
* You're familiar with modern cloud environments
* You're no stranger to using AI tools where it makes sense to you
* We stick to English in our codebases, in our written documentation, and in our communication. You'll have a better time if you additionally have decent German language skills as we often interface with other teams and stakeholders in German.

  

  

**What we offer**  

  

* A dynamic working environment with room for ideas and creativity
* An uncomplicated company culture
* Exciting projects and tasks with a high degree of responsibility
* Employee benefits and discounts on Valora formats
* A variety of exciting online training courses at the Valora Academy
* Fair employment conditions
* Flex model in our offices in Muttenz and/or Zurich

jobs.title: Senior Solutions Architect
jobs.description:
We are looking for passionate technologists to join our Pre\-Sales organization to ensure that our growth is grounded and guided by strong technical alignment with our platform and the needs of our customers.



MongoDB Pre\-Sales Solution Architects are responsible for guiding our customers and users to design and build reliable, scalable systems using our data platform. Our team is made up of seasoned technical sales professionals, software architects, entrepreneurs, and developers who take direct responsibility for customer success, including the design of their software, deployment, and operations. You'll work closely with our sales executives, helping customers solve business problems by leveraging our solutions, playing a key role in winning deals and driving the business forward. You'll be a trusted advisor to a wide range of users from startups to the world's largest enterprise IT organizations.



We are looking to speak to candidates who are based in Madrid for our hybrid working model.


### **As an ideal candidate, you will have:**


* Ideally 8 to 11 years of related experience in a customer facing role, with 5 to 7 years of experience in pre\-sales with enterprise software
* Minimum of 3 years experience with modern scripting languages (e.g. Python, Node.js, SQL) and/or popular programming languages (e.g. C/C\+\+, Java, C\#) in a professional capacity
* Experience designing with scalable and highly available distributed systems in the cloud and on\-prem
* Demonstrated ability to work with customers to review complex architecture of existing applications, providing guidance on how to improve by leveraging technology
* Excellent presentation, communication, and interpersonal skills, with the ability to convey complex technical and business concepts in a clear and compelling manner to technology and business leadership
* Ability to strategize with sales teams and provide recommendations on how to drive a multi\-threaded account strategy, aligning other MongoDB and ecosystem resources to move towards a mutually beneficial account plan
* The ability to travel up to 25%
* A Bachelor's degree or equivalent work experience

### **You may also have:**


* Experience selling databases and/or deploying applications with any of the major cloud providers
* Experience with database programming and data models
* Experience in data engineering or AI/ML projects
* Experience in transforming legacy systems and platforms into modern, scalable, and efficient technology stacks
* Understanding of popular sales methodologies/ frameworks such as MEDDPICC/ Command of the Message
* A MongoDB Certification
* A Cloud Provider Certification

### **What you do at MongoDB:**



In this role, you will work on complex opportunities where analysis of situations or data requires an in\-depth evaluation of various factors. You will:


* Design and Architect: Design scalable and performant applications, systems and infrastructure for large software projects leveraging MongoDB
* Customer Advising and Value Articulation: Guide customers on architecture patterns and optimisation strategies for MongoDB, while clearly communicating its business value to the relevant stakeholders
* Sales Partnership: Collaborate with the sales team to drive account success through account planning, opportunity prioritization/qualification and pipeline generation strategy, while taking ownership of the technical aspects (including but not limited to technical discovery, demos, proof of value, presentations, sizing and documentation)
* Demand Generation: Proactively generate demand within the sales territory through self\-driven technical initiatives, participation in events such as industry trade shows and account\-based marketing events
* Customer Success: Foster strong customer relationships, build champions and ensure customer success and satisfaction
* Innovation and Improvement: Continuously seek opportunities to innovate and improve MongoDB solutions and processes (e.g. by relaying field feedback to the product team), as well as proactively mentor other Solutions Consulting team members
* Personal Training and Development: Engage in ongoing training and professional development to stay abreast of MongoDB product suite as well as industry trends

### **What you will learn:**



MongoDB Product Suite Mastery:


* Core Database Server: Master the fundamentals and advanced features of MongoDB's core database
* Atlas and Advanced Services: Gain expertise in Atlas (fully managed cloud database service), Atlas Stream Processing, Atlas Data Lake, Atlas Full\-Text Search, Atlas Vector Search, and Charts
* Relational Migrator: Learn to migrate from relational databases seamlessly


Market\-Relevant Technologies:


* Hyperscaler Ecosystem: Gain expertise in designing complex systems utilizing cloud services on hyperscaler platforms
* Complementary Technologies: Enhance your skills with partner and complementary technologies such as Apache Kafka and Kubernetes


Modern Architecture Design:


* Design Patterns and Methodologies: Embrace best practices in microservices, DevOps, cloud, and security
* Cutting Edge RAG and AI Architectures: Help customers on their generative AI journeys and working with industry leading partners in the space


Sales Techniques and Soft Skills:


* Effective Communication: Master presentations, demonstrations, and whiteboarding
* Client Interaction: Develop strategies for discovery and objection handling


Industry Insights:


* Diverse Market Verticals: Gain exposure to a broad spectrum of interesting use cases across various industries

### **About MongoDB**



MongoDB is built for change, empowering our customers and our people to innovate at the speed of the market. We have redefined the data platform for the AI era, enabling builders to create, transform, and disrupt industries with software. MongoDB's unified data platform, the most widely available, globally distributed data platform on the market, helps organizations modernize legacy workloads, embrace innovation, and unleash AI. Our cloud\-native platform, MongoDB Atlas, is the only globally distributed, multi\-cloud data platform and is available across AWS, Google Cloud, and Microsoft Azure.



With offices worldwide and over 67,000 customers, including AI\-native startups and approximately 75% of the Fortune 100, relying on MongoDB for their most important applications, we're powering the next era of software.



Our compass at MongoDB is our Leadership Commitment, guiding how and why we make decisions, show up for each other, and win. It's what makes us MongoDB.



To drive the personal growth and business impact of our employees, we're committed to developing a supportive and enriching culture for everyone. From employee affinity groups, to fertility assistance and a generous parental leave policy, we value our employees' wellbeing and want to support them along every step of their professional and personal journeys. Learn more about what it's like to work at MongoDB, and help us make an impact on the world!



MongoDB is committed to providing any necessary accommodations for individuals with disabilities within our application and interview process. To request an accommodation due to a disability, please inform your recruiter.



MongoDB is an equal opportunities employer.

jobs.title: Clinical Data Engineer CDP & DP
jobs.description:
**Clinical Data Engineer CDP \& DP**

  


  

  

**Main Purpose**

  



Drives the setup and maintenance of clinical data collection instrument(s), data ingestion and integration capabilities from all study data sources (sites and vendors – labs, IRT, ePRO, digital devices, etc.), based on the Clinical Study Protocol and Medical Standards in collaboration with the study team and other internal as well as external stakeholders.



Implements programs/listings for data quality checks as well as builds optimized data flow pipelines to enable risk monitoring processes (CDM, Med Review, Site Management, Med Coding) and statistical analysis/reporting.

  


**Key Tasks \& Responsibilities**

  


* Requirements \& Specification: Analyze clinical protocol to create requirements and technical specifications for data collection, data ingestion, quality measures, data integration and transformation for all study sources ensuring complete end\-to\-end focus.
* Task Delivery: Setup study level data collection elements as well as program triggers, derivations and data cleaning checks/listings/reports. Setup and perform data ingestion activities for CRO and vendor data, data exchanges with internal and external partner systems, as per agreed data transfer specifications. Develop and validate programs for study setup, conduct and closeout activities within the Clinical Data Environment/Lakehouse. Provide clinical study data to business users, ensuring smooth data flow and traceability while addressing any data flow issues.
* Project Management: Plan, prioritize, and communicate timelines for clinical studies. Support these studies throughout their lifecycle by evaluating issues, assessing the impact of changes, and implementing and testing updates. Ensure all study setup documentation is completed on time and comply with relevant SOPs to be ready for inspections and audits.
* Best Practices: Contribute as a subject matter expert for function level processes, systems/tools.

  




**Scope**

  


* Global

  




**Key Work Relations (Internal/External)**

  


* Clinical Study Team Members: Study Managers, Study Data Managers, Medical Experts, Statisticians, Statistical Programmers, Medical Writing, Drug Safety, Medical Coding)
* Technology Related Partners: IT System Owners, DSA\&I Process Managers/Clinical Data Engineers/Project Managers/Scrum Masters
* Enabling Functions: Standards Management, Vendor Management, Procurement, Customer Centricity, etc.
* External vendors and partner companies

  




**Skills \& Qualifications**

  

* Education: Bachelor's or Master's degree in Natural Sciences, Life Sciences, Statistics, Computer Science, Data Science or related fields. Equivalent degrees or certifications may be accepted.
* Experience: At least 3 years in a scientific, data\-driven position, preferably with experience working in the clinical data management discipline.
* Technology \& Programming: In\-depth experience in programming languages (e.g., C\#, SQL, SAS, Python, R) and clinical information systems following software development processes.
* Familiarity with big data technologies, cloud infrastructure (AWS, Azure, GCP), and data integration tools (e.g., Databricks).
* Industry Practices \- Preferred: Understanding of global regulatory requirements and guidelines (e.g., ICH, GCP, HIPAA) related to clinical investigations and data collection. Knowledge of CDISC clinical data standards.
* Self Organization: Strong organizational and time management skills, with the ability to work independently and collaboratively in a global environment.
* Communication \& Collaboration: Strong communication skills in English, both written and verbal. Proven ability to collaborate with internal and external stakeholders demonstrating decision making capabilities.
