jobs.title: DevOps Engineer
jobs.description:
**About Us**  

  

Perk (formerly TravelPerk) is the intelligent platform for travel and spend management. Built to tackle the time\-consuming, manual work that gets in the way of real work, our tools automate everything from travel bookings to expenses, invoice processing, and more. By eliminating this shadow work that wastes hours, erodes morale, and saps innovation, we're on a mission to power real work, with real impact.  

  

We're trusted by more than 12,000 companies worldwide, including Bolt, GoCardless, and Fabletics, and we're tackling the 7 hours of lost productivity per employee each week, a $1\.7 trillion problem.  

  

Founded in 2015, Perk has grown into a global company of more than 1,800 people across 12 offices globally, with headquarters in London and Boston. We combine innovation, control, and simplicity to transform how businesses work and how people feel at work.  

  

At Perk, we're driven by our values, like being an owner, delivering a 7\-star experience, and working as one team. We value curiosity, purpose, and mindset, not just knowledge, to unlock the power in your potential. Our talent team brings together leading minds from the travel, fintech, and SaaS industries, representing over 70 countries. If you're excited about having a real impact and shaping how millions of people experience work, we'd love you on the team.  

  

Visit www.perk.com to learn more.


The Platform function at Perk builds the foundations that the rest of the company depends on. We own the shared infrastructure, core services, and developer tooling that enable product teams to move fast without breaking things. Our work is often behind the scenes, but its impact is everywhere: reliability, scalability, security, and developer experience.


We solve hard, systemic problems, make deliberate trade\-offs, and hold ourselves accountable for the long\-term health of the platform. If you care about leverage, clean abstractions, and building things other engineers actually enjoy using, you’ll feel at home here.


We are seeking a **DevOps Engineer** to join our team and help build, maintain, and scale the infrastructure and tools that empower our developers to deliver reliable, secure, and high\-performing services. If you’re an experienced Platform Engineer, or a Software Engineer with a passion for Platform and Developer Experience, we would love to speak with you.

**Responsibilities:**
---------------------

* Design, build and maintain scalable, and reliable cloud infrastructure in AWS
* Enable development teams to be owners of their systems and to deliver high impact products to our users
* Partner with SRE and security teams to help developers build resilient and secure applications
* Participate in our on\-call and incident management process as part of a “you build it, you run it” mentality

**Requirements:**
-----------------

* Hands\-on experience managing systems in AWS (EC2, S3, RDS, IAM, VPC, etc.)
* Strong knowledge of Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, Pulumi, etc.)
* Solid understanding of CI/CD practices and tools (GitHub Actions, CircleCI, etc.)
* Experience with monitoring and observability tools (Datadog, CloudWatch, etc.)
* Experience with containerisation and container orchestration (Docker, ECS, etc.)
* Proficiency in at least one programming/scripting language (Python, Go, etc.)
* Strong problem\-solving and troubleshooting skills in distributed systems
* Excellent communication and collaboration abilities

### **Advantageous but not essential:**

* Comfortable working across a mostly Linux estate, with some exposure to Windows systems and .NET applications
* Experience with serverless architectures
* Experience with defining advanced cloud networking setups
* Familiarity with SOC2, ISO 27001, or other compliance frameworks

**AI at Perk**  

AI is embedded in how we work across every function. The tools you'll use day\-to\-day are AI\-enabled so you can move faster and spend more time on the work that matters. In practice, that means using AI to research and prioritise accounts, draft and refine outreach, handle customer interactions more effectively, synthesise information, and cut through shadow work \- the invisible tasks that pull people away from the work only they can do \- so you can focus on relationships and outcomes.

**How We Work**


At Perk, we take an IRL\-first approach to work, where our team works together in\-person 3 days a week. As such, this role requires you to be based within commuting distance of our hubs. We fundamentally believe in the value of meeting in real life to improve connectivity, productivity, creativity and ultimately making us a great place to work.


For certain roles, we can help with relocation from anywhere in the world, English is the official language at the office. Please submit your resume in English if you choose to apply. Do not forget to submit an updated portfolio and/or resume.


Perk is a global company with a diverse customer base, and we want to make sure the people behind our product reflect that. We’re an equal opportunity employer, which means you’re welcome at Perk regardless of how you look, where you’re from, or anything else that makes you, well, you.

**Protect Yourself from Recruitment Scams**


All official communication from Perk will always come from email addresses ending in @perk.com or @externalperk.com, our verified social media channels, or recruiters listed on our official LinkedIn page. We will never ask you to pay for equipment, training, or fees, request sensitive personal information such as bank details early in the process, or communicate through unofficial apps like WhatsApp, Telegram, or Signal. If you receive a message claiming to be from Perk that seems suspicious, please do not respond. Forward it to security \[at] perk .com, and we will confirm whether it is legitimate.

jobs.title: SAP Solution Engineer
jobs.description:
**World leader in allergy**


ALK is a global specialty pharmaceutical company based in Denmark, dedicated to allergy treatment and innovation for over a century. Present in 46 markets with production sites in the USA, Spain, France, and Denmark, we reach 3\.1 million patients annually and aim to help 5 million people living with allergies by 2030\.


Our 2,800 employees support this mission, with Global IT enabling modern technologies and world\-class support across the organization. The SAP solution is embarking on an S4HANA migration, and we are seeking an SAP Basis Consultant to strengthen our team.


**What will be your role?**


You will join to company's SAP global support team, a global department of about 30 people located at different sites in Europe, most of them located in Madrid, working in close collaboration with other SAP specialist in Global IT \- SAP Team.


**Your main functions will be:**

* Working in collaboration with colleagues within Global IT and end users around the world, you will take part in designing, installing, implementing, configuring, replacing, and documenting our SAP system platforms from an SAP Basis perspective.
* You will support, troubleshoot, and develop existing and future SAP systems and services and related, to ensure the highest level of performance and stability. It will include daily management, security management, kernel updates, system updates, homogeneous copies, EWA reviews, DRTs, troubleshooting.
* You will be also involved in the projects for developing our SAP landscape in the future either through implementing new systems or upgrading and enhancing the existing ones.
* Adhering to compliance and writing documentation based on Pharma regulations (GxP). Experience and demonstrated ability to achieve a kind of compliance is a must.
* Assisting in maintenance and release cycle tasks and working with team members to complete tasks needed for various projects.
* Travel around 10%.
* Occasional work on weekends, 1\-2 weekends per month, SAP system and OS Security patching, SAP Release support, Datacenter and Operations support.
* Availability during the emergency situations, semi \- on call availability.


**What We're Seeking:**

* An education in computer science, engineering or similar.
* Structured, able to work autonomously and to plan, structure and execute your own tasks or projects including coordination with colleagues and stakeholders.
* With good documentation skills and attention to details and accuracy.
* Proactive, service\-minded and team player attitude.
* Experience working with Agile methodologies.
* Experience in working on regulated environments with strong compliance requirements.

 **Your knowledge of SAP must include:**

* You have been working the last 5\-10 years in the SAP Basis area and you’re used to work with cross function cooperation, quality mindset, timely delivery and compliance requirements being in high focus, and you are now ready for new challenges.
* Record of development and maintenance activities on system documentation for all SAP instances and interfaces following GxP standards.
* Experience in the administration of different SAP products: SAP ECC, SAP PI/PO, SAP ATTP, SAP BW, SAP BO, Solution Manager, Content Servers, S/4HANA, Hana Cockpit…
* Experience in SAP Cloud Services and applications (BTP/BDC//BAIP) like SII, DRC, BAS, Datasphere, Integration Suite, SAP Cloud ALM, SAP ICH, SAP Concur …
* Base knowledge of Security and SAP Security, Securing Hardening, System Parameters tuning.
* Base knowledge of Certificates, SAP Certificate Management Cloud and On\-Prem, network connectivity and integrations.
* Good English command and communication skills is a must.


 Valuable:

* Experience in DB management such as: HANA / MS\-SQL\-Server / DB2(DB4\)/MariaDB.
* Experience in OS administration, such as: Linux (SLES,SLE MICRO, SUSE Rancher, Kubernetes), IBM I OS 400, Windows .
* Experience in DR architectures and/or Business Continuity Plans
* Experience in archiving , including configuration of the archiving objects, planning, and execution of the archiving jobs.
* Experience with CHARM and System monitoring in SAP Solution Manager and in SAP Cloud ALM
* Experience in S/4HANA migrations.
* Experience with AI, mainly Joule Agent
* ITIL and ServiceNow experience.


**What can we offer you?**

* Stable contract
* To join a Company that’s consolidated and shows a great international growth, in which the most important element are the people that belong to it
* Interesting incentives and social benefits

**Why ALK Global IT?**


ALK’s IT division is a robust team of approximately 140 professionals with IT hubs in Hørsholm, Madrid, Krakow, and with employees throughout our production and sales networks in Germany, France, and North America and China. We prioritize professional growth and learning, valuing competency and knowledge exchange over formalities and encouraging a collaborative spirit every day.


You will have the opportunity to contribute to and make an impact on:

* Our SAP S/4HANA journey
* SAP CONCUR
* SAP Integrations solution
* Advancing AI, Analytics and digitalisation throughout ALK
* The Implementation of the global serialization solutions
* And many more innovative ventures!


**Become a part of ALK**


ALK provides a dynamic and accommodating work environment, complete with inspiring and challenging assignments. You are able to actively influence and challenge the status quo. Our flat structures attract independent individuals who like to feel the progress of the business and enjoy being close to the decision\-making process. We consider our pioneering spirit, coupled with our trustworthiness, our winning formula.


We operate production sites in Denmark, France, Spain, and the United States, with a global team of approximately 2,900 employees. Our headquarters is located in the scenic DTU Science Park in Hørsholm, Denmark. However, for this role, your primary workplace will be at our centrally located office in Madrid, where you’ll be part of a dynamic team of 350 colleagues.


Join us at ALK and be a part of an organization that values integrity, innovation, and making a difference in the lives of those we serve.

  

Don’t miss the chance to impact the allergy world and advance your career with ALK. Apply today!

The Business Unit Tax \& Accounting Software develops and sells products for tax and accounting professionals. Our BU offers a wide range of software solutions: ERP software; accounting, financial and tax advisory, and practice management software.

C\#, .NET Standard, Azure DevOps, Test Driven Development, Entity Framework, Domain Driven Design, ASP.NET Core, Azure, App Services, App Insights, Git, Angular, JavaScript, TypeScript, SASS, Azure Service Bus, SQL Elastic Pools, Azure Functions, Redis, Power BI, Elastic SQL Jobs, API Gateway, ARM templates, Azure AD, Identity Server, OWIN, OAuth2, OpenID Connect

### **Description \& Requirements**


**Introduction: Career at HARMAN Automotive**


At HARMAN Automotive, we are shaping the future of connected vehicles by bringing innovative technologies from development into high\-volume manufacturing. As part of the Advanced Manufacturing Engineering Test organization, you will help implement and industrialize automotive electronics products such as Infotainment Systems, Audio Amplifiers, Telematics Control Units (TCUs), and other connected vehicle platforms.


* **Develop and implement** manufacturing test solutions that enable the successful launch of complex automotive electronics products.
* **Partner with global teams** across engineering, quality, suppliers, and manufacturing to deliver robust and efficient production processes.
* **Advance manufacturing excellence** through automation, standardization, and continuous improvement of test technologies and methodologies.
* **Support the future of mobility** by ensuring the quality and reliability of connected, intelligent, and customer\-focused automotive systems.

**What You’ll Be Part Of**


As a Regional AME Test Engineer, you will play a key role in shaping the test strategy and manufacturing test infrastructure for next\-generation automotive products. Working as an individual contributor, you will partner with cross\-functional teams across engineering, quality, manufacturing, suppliers, and global technology organizations to develop reliable, efficient, and standardized test solutions. Your work will directly impact product quality, production efficiency, and the successful launch of new technologies into manufacturing. This position is a strong fit for engineers who enjoy technical ownership, continuous improvement, and delivering innovative test solutions in a global environment.


**How You’ll Make An Impact**


* Develop manufacturing test concepts, specifications, and validation strategies that ensure product quality and support successful product launches.
* Lead the development and implementation of hardware and software solutions for test equipment, enabling reliable and efficient testing throughout the product lifecycle.
* Collaborate with product development, quality, manufacturing, and supplier teams to deliver robust test systems that meet customer, regulatory, and production requirements.
* Optimize test processes, cycle times, and test coverage to improve manufacturing efficiency, reduce quality risks, and lower operational costs.
* Drive continuous improvement by introducing new test technologies, measurement methods, and industry best practices into manufacturing operations.
* Coordinate test equipment deployment from concept through commissioning, ensuring systems are ready for prototype builds, industrialization, and serial production.
* Contribute to global engineering standards, knowledge sharing, and lessons learned activities to strengthen test engineering capabilities across HARMAN locations.

**What Makes You A Strong Fit**


* Strong understanding of manufacturing test engineering principles, including test concepts, validation methodologies, and production test systems.
* Ability to design, develop, and troubleshoot test equipment hardware and software in a manufacturing environment.
* Working knowledge of C\# programming for the development, maintenance, and continuous improvement of manufacturing test applications and automation solutions.
* Solid understanding of electronics fundamentals, including analog and digital circuits, measurement techniques, signal analysis, and hardware troubleshooting.
* Knowledge of measurement techniques, data analysis, and test coverage optimization to improve product quality and manufacturing performance.
* Strong problem\-solving skills with the ability to identify root causes and implement sustainable corrective actions.
* Effective collaboration and communication skills to work with cross\-functional teams, suppliers, and international engineering organizations.
* Ability to independently manage technical activities, prioritize tasks, and drive results in a dynamic manufacturing environment.
* A continuous improvement mindset focused on innovation, standardization, and operational excellence.
* We see AI as an important part of how work gets done. While tools may vary, a baseline familiarity with using AI to support efficiency, problem\-solving, and quality is expected.

**Bonus Points if You Have**

* Experience with automotive electronics manufacturing and end\-of\-line test systems.
* Familiarity with industrial test platforms, automated measurement equipment, or fixture development.
* Knowledge of statistical methods such as MSA, capability analysis, or process performance evaluation.
* Experience working with international suppliers and global engineering teams.
* Understanding of automotive quality standards and processes, including IATF 16949 requirements.

**Things To Know**


* This role is based in Székesfehérvár, Hungary and supports global automotive manufacturing and engineering activities.
* Occasional domestic and international travel may be required to support suppliers, manufacturing sites, and engineering teams.
* Professional working proficiency in English is required to collaborate effectively with global engineering and business partners.
* This role requires close cooperation with cross\-functional teams, including Product Development, Quality, Manufacturing, Purchasing, and external suppliers.
* The position involves supporting both new product introductions and serial production environments, requiring flexibility and effective prioritization of activities.

**What You Can Expect**


* A hybrid work environment that balances flexibility with in\-person collaboration, with most office\-based roles onsite three days a week.
* Access to employee discounts on HARMAN and Samsung products (including JBL, Harman / Kardon, AKG, and others)
* Learning and development opportunities through our award\-winning HARMAN University programs
* Wellness benefits designed to support your overall well\-being
* Tuition reimbursement support
* Access to the HARMAN campus fitness center and cafeteria, where available
* An inclusive and diverse work environment that supports both your professional and personal development.
* The opportunity to work on advanced automotive technologies and products used by leading global vehicle manufacturers.
* A collaborative international environment with strong connections across engineering, manufacturing, and innovation teams.
* Continuous learning opportunities through technical training, global knowledge\-sharing initiatives, and professional development programs.
* The ability to influence manufacturing standards, test strategies, and future technology roadmaps.
* A culture focused on innovation, teamwork, continuous improvement, and engineering excellence.
  
  

**Pay Transparency**
Ft 9,270,000 \- Ft 13,596,000
The above represents the annual gross base salary range for this role.  

  

**Variable compensation and allowances:** Dependent on the position offered, other forms of compensation may also be available, such as quarterly or annual bonus pay, commission payments, long term incentive compensation, or certain allowances. Further details will be made available as part of the recruitment process.  

  

**How we set pay:** The pay posted is a reasonable estimate of the wage range anticipated for this position. Pay is determined using objective, job\-related criteria such as relevant experience, skills, role scope/responsibilities, and location\-based market factors (where applicable). In appropriate circumstances, based on objective, job\-related factors, the final determination on pay may deviate from the posted range.  

  

**Pay history:** Please do not include current or past pay information in your application. We do not request pay history as part of our recruitment process.  

  

**Benefits:** HARMAN is interested in supporting the health and wellbeing of employees and offers a range of benefits. Offerings vary by country and employment arrangement and reflect a combination of statutory requirements and company\-provided programs. These may include paid time off and holidays, sick and family leave, as well as health and wellbeing support and retirement or savings plans where applicable, along with other locally relevant benefits. Further details will be made available as part of the recruitment process.  

  

**About HARMAN: Where Innovation Unleashes Next\-Level Technology**
Ever since the 1920s, we’ve been amplifying the sense of sound. Today, that legacy endures, with integrated technology platforms that make the world smarter, safer, and more connected.  

  

Across automotive, lifestyle, and digital transformation solutions, we create innovative technologies that turn ordinary moments into extraordinary experiences. Our renowned automotive and lifestyle solutions can be found everywhere, from the music we play in our cars and homes to venues that feature today’s most sought\-after performers, while our digital transformation solutions serve humanity by addressing the world’s ever\-evolving needs and demands. Marketing our award\-winning portfolio under 16 iconic brands, such as JBL, Mark Levinson, and Revel, we set ourselves apart by exceeding the highest engineering and design standards for our customers, our partners and each other.  

  

If you’re ready to innovate and do work that makes a lasting impact, join our talent community today!

HARMAN is committed to making every employee feel welcomed, valued, and empowered. We also recognize that learning is a lifelong pursuit and want you to flourish. We proudly offer added opportunities for training, development, and continuing education, further empowering you to live the career you want.  

  

HARMAN is proud to be an Equal Opportunity employer. HARMAN strives to hire the best qualified candidates and is committed to building a workforce representative of the diverse marketplaces and communities of our global colleagues and customers. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, gender (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, or other applicable legally protected characteristics. HARMAN attracts, hires, and develops employees based on merit, qualifications and job\-related performance.(www.harman.com)  

  

HARMAN is committed to providing reasonable accommodations to applicants with disabilities. If you need assistance or an accommodation during the application process, please contact us at harmancareers@harman.com. Requests will be considered on a case\-by\-case basis in accordance with applicable law.

jobs.description:
Location Abu Dhabi Category Engineering, Technology, \& Science Job Type Full time Job Id R2128947 Posted Date 08/26/2026  


JOB DESCRIPTION
**Title:**


The Specialist Digitalization Engineer (Greenfield)
***Belong, Connect, Grow, with KBR!***


***The KBR team delivers future\-forward science, technology and engineering solutions and mission\-critical services that help governments and companies around the world accomplish their most important objectives, while also helping achieve their sustainability goals. KBR Sustainable Technology Solutions provides holistic and value\-added solutions across the entire asset life cycle. These include world\-class licensed process technologies, differentiated advisory services, deep technical domain expertise, energy transition solutions, high\-end design and engineering capabilities, and smart solutions to optimize planned and operating assets.***


**Job Title: The Specialist Digitalization Engineer (Greenfield)**

KBR Abu Dhabi PMC Team is currently seeking experienced professionals for the position listed below in support of a major Offshore Project. The role will be based at either the Client's Office or the Contractor's Office in Abu Dhabi, UAE.


**Job Purpose**


The Specialist Digitalization Engineer (Greenfield) is responsible for leading and coordinating digital engineering, information management, smart asset, and digital transformation initiatives during the execution of the Offshore Project. The role ensures seamless integration of digital tools, engineering data, asset information models, digital twin solutions, and operational readiness requirements throughout the project lifecycle from FEED through EPC, commissioning, start\-up, and handover.


The position plays a critical role in establishing ADNOC's digital asset foundation and ensuring that all engineering, procurement, construction, and commissioning data are structured and delivered to support future operations, maintenance, reliability, and asset performance management.


**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------


### **Digitalization Strategy \& Governance**


* Develop and implement project digitalization strategies in line with ADNOC Offshore standards and digital transformation objectives.
* Define digital engineering requirements, workflows, data standards, and governance frameworks.
* Ensure compliance with ADNOC Information Management and Digitalization requirements.
* Establish project digital execution plans and monitor implementation across EPC contractors and vendors.

### **Digital Engineering \& Information Management**


* Lead implementation of Digital Engineering and Smart Asset methodologies for greenfield offshore facilities.
* Ensure engineering data, vendor data, and project documentation are captured in accordance with project information standards.
* Develop and maintain Project Information Models (PIM) and Asset Information Models (AIM).
* Define metadata standards, data taxonomy, coding structures, and information classification schemes.
* Manage engineering information throughout the project lifecycle.

### **Digital Twin \& Smart Asset Development**


* Support implementation of Digital Twin and Smart Asset initiatives for offshore platforms and associated facilities.
* Ensure design and engineering deliverables are suitable for Digital Twin deployment and lifecycle management.
* Coordinate integration of engineering models, operational data, and maintenance information.
* Support digitization of asset performance and operational readiness requirements.

### **Systems Integration**


* Coordinate integration between:
	+ Engineering design systems
	+ Document management systems
	+ Asset management systems
	+ Maintenance management systems
	+ Process control and automation systems
	+ Data analytics and reporting platforms
* Ensure effective transfer of engineering information from EPC contractors to ADNOC operational systems.
* Facilitate interoperability between engineering software platforms and digital asset solutions.

### **Data Quality \& Governance**


* Establish project data quality requirements and validation processes.
* Conduct periodic audits and assessments of digital deliverables.
* Monitor completeness, consistency, and accuracy of engineering and asset data.
* Manage data cleansing, validation, and migration activities.

### **Construction, Commissioning \& Handover Support**


* Ensure digital deliverables are aligned with construction and commissioning requirements.
* Support development of asset registers and equipment master data.
* Coordinate digital asset readiness activities during commissioning and start\-up phases.
* Lead preparation and verification of digital handover packages to operations.
* Validate final data delivery and operational information readiness.

### **Analytics \& Reporting**


* Develop digital performance dashboards and project reporting tools.
* Monitor digitalization KPIs and project information maturity.
* Support analysis of engineering and operational data.
* Generate management reports related to digital transformation progress.

### **Cybersecurity \& Compliance**


* Support implementation of cybersecurity requirements for digital systems.
* Ensure compliance with ADNOC digital governance frameworks and industry best practices.
* Participate in project audits, assurance reviews, and digitalization assessments.

**Minimum Qualifications**
--------------------------


Bachelor's Degree in:


* Computer Engineering
* Information Systems
* Instrumentation \& Control Engineering
* Electrical Engineering
* Automation Engineering
* Computer Science
* Other relevant engineering discipline

Master's Degree in Digital Engineering, Data Management, Information Systems, or related discipline is advantageous.


**Experience Requirements**
---------------------------


* Minimum **15 years** of experience in Oil \& Gas, Energy, Petrochemical, or Major Infrastructure Projects.
* Minimum **7 years** of experience in Digitalization, Information Management, Digital Engineering, or Smart Asset implementation.
* Proven experience in **Greenfield Offshore EPC/EPCI projects**.
* Experience supporting large ADNOC, Saudi Aramco, QatarEnergy, Shell, BP, TotalEnergies, ExxonMobil, or similar projects is preferred.
* Experience in project execution from FEED to Start\-up and Operations Handover.
* Demonstrated experience with Digital Twin and Asset Information Management implementation.

**Technical Skills**
--------------------


### **Essential**


* Digital Engineering
* Smart Asset Management
* Asset Information Management (AIM)
* Project Information Management (PIM)
* Digital Twin Solutions
* Engineering Data Management
* Asset Data Governance
* Information Lifecycle Management
* Data Quality Management
* Master Data Management
* Systems Integration
* Industrial Digital Transformation

### **Software \& Platforms**


Experience with one or more of the following:


* AVEVA Engineering / AVEVA AIM

**Certifications (Preferred)**
------------------------------

new_jobs.title: Software Engineer
new_jobs.description:
**Be the true you**
-------------------



Build robust software solutions. Join our innovation team developing and implementing technical solutions that solve real business challenges. Design, build, and scale software that directly impacts how our organization works. At Deloitte.


**Benefits**
------------


* You’ll receive a profit\-sharing bonus, on top of your fixed salary.
* Continuous professional growth. Join our development program.
* A work\-from\-home office setup allowance to make sure you have everything you need for an ergonomically designed workstation and internet allowance.
* Work part\-time (32 hours a week) or full\-time (40 hours a week).
* Flexible and hybrid working, in accordance with team and client commitments.
* 26 days of paid annual leave, and the opportunity to purchase additional leave.
* A good mobility scheme: the choice of various options such as a lease car, travel by public transport, a cash option or a combination of these.
* A laptop and iPhone. The iPhone can also be used for personal purposes.
* A time for time arrangement that creates flexibility for personal moments that matter.
* A good pension scheme with a personal contribution of only 2%.
* An opportunity to take part in our collective health insurance scheme.
* An opportunity to benefit from tax\-efficient facilities such as company fitness, a bicycle scheme or the opportunity to lease a bicycle.
* The opportunity to use 55 hours of babysitting service per calendar year if your child is 12 years old or younger.
* A flexible budget, which you can use to make choices in flexible benefits, for example purchasing extra leave days or financing a bicycle plan.
* Various leave options tailored to meet your individual needs, from parental leave (also for rainbow families) to the flexibility of exchanging three national holidays for non\-national holidays.

**Be the true you**
-------------------



We have a dynamic way of working, which means not all our solutions work with the same stack. One day you’re building the newest prototype we’d like to develop for our Audit department, the next day one of our battle\-tested solutions requires its monthly software update. Your mental context window allows you to do both in the same week, in addition to this expectation, we are looking for someone that identifies with the following profile:

* Has a few years of experience with developing production\-grade software using C\#, Java, Python or TypeScript and is well\-versed in architectures that are usually occurring in those languages.
* Previously has worked with technology that enables those products, think of AWS, GCP or Azure
* Experience packaging and running applications in containers, using Docker and an orchestrator such as Kubernetes.
* Have collaborated with other developers via Git, using a platform like GitHub or Azure DevOps
* Able to communicate about their work, both the outcome and process, estimations and possible issues


**What impact will you make?**
------------------------------



Team Tomorrow is a team of \~90 employees with a very wide array of skills. We’re innovating how Deloitte works by optimizing internal processes, implementing novel technical solutions, and generally elevating how our colleague’s work. As a Software Engineer, you’re part of our group of Builders. We are responsible for delivering technical solutions, developing rapid prototype(s) and serving as experts for our colleagues that are not involved in the technical part of these solutions.


**How do you do this?**
-----------------------



As a Software Engineer, you will be actively involved in the development of our solutions in collaboration with designers, product owners and other engineers, as well as stakeholders in the business. You have a curious mind, in the age of AI simply writing code doesn’t just do it for you. You want to understand how and why code works and why some solutions are used within a specific context. You have an eye for detail and take a proactive approach when creating new features and/or solutions. Your expertise is valued within all steps of the process from idea to product.


In addition to creating, you also value growth and learning for yourself and your colleagues. We invite you to learn from us and have us learn things from you. This can be about a niche subject you’re captivated by or the newest version of a front\-end framework.


Beyond that, we value ownership and eminence. We don’t expect you to understand and/or master everything when you join, but we expect you to continuously learn and grow in this matter. Your basics are strong and from there, you’re open to exploring more advanced and complex patterns. AI serves as your accelerator, not as your substitution. Among all the points mentioned above, we have some indicators whether you could be suited for this role:

* You have a foundational knowledge of a language like C\#, Java, Python or similar and have worked with this in a production environment for a few years.
* In addition, you’ve embedded frameworks or plugins using package managers and are familiar with the ecosystems that surround the mentioned languages above.
* Collaboration is key, which means that you are suited to work with Git and can share your work on GitHub or a similar environment. This also means you’re able to explain your code in writing and speech.
* You are a curious, creative, and social person. We don’t expect you to immediately stand in front of all of us to present, but you are communicative by nature, are okay to challenge people on their ideas and not afraid to receive constructive feedback.
* Our core business is innovation, so keeping up with trends and/or taking an active role in learning new things is expected.

**Questions or doubts? Get in touch.**
--------------------------------------


Marit Oudman (Recruiter)

new_jobs.title: Product Developer Stagiar(e)
new_jobs.description:
Wij zijn op zoek naar een enthousiaste Product Developer Stagiair(e) met een leergierige en actieve houding



**Enthousiaste Product Developer Stagiair(e) gezocht!**
-------------------------------------------------------


**Standplaats:** Apeldoorn (deels hybride)
  

**Uren:** 39 uur per week (fulltime)
  

**Start:** zo snel mogelijk


**Wil jij niet alleen leren hoe software wordt ontwikkeld, maar er ook écht aan meebouwen?**
  

Bij Paragon krijg je als stagiair Product Developer de kans om ervaring op te doen met echte softwareproducten, moderne Microsoft\-technologie en een professioneel developmentteam. Je draait mee met ervaren developers én krijgt ruimte voor een eigen stageproject dat aansluit bij jouw interesses en leerdoelen.


### **Jouw stage bij Paragon**


Als **Product Developer stagiair** maak je kennis met het volledige softwareontwikkelproces. Van het eerste idee en het vertalen van wensen naar requirements, tot ontwikkelen, testen en uiteindelijk het uitrollen van software die dagelijks door klanten wordt gebruikt.
  

  

Ongeveer **70% van je tijd werk je mee in het Business ICT\-team**. Je leert van ervaren collega's, pakt echte werkzaamheden op en ontdekt hoe het er in een professionele Agile\-omgeving aan toegaat.
  

  

De overige **30% besteed je aan je eigen stageproject**. Samen met je begeleider kies je een concreet project dat past bij jouw opleiding, interesses en leerdoelen. Zo combineer je praktijkervaring met een eigen resultaat waar je aan het einde van je stage met trots op kunt terugkijken.


### **Wat ga je doen?**


Tijdens je stage krijg je de mogelijkheid om mee te werken aan verschillende onderdelen van softwareontwikkeling. Denk bijvoorbeeld aan:


* Ontwerpen, bouwen en testen van softwareapplicaties met C\#/.NET
* Werken met Microsoft Azure en Azure Functions
* Meewerken volgens Agile en deelnemen aan sprintplanningen en stand\-ups
* Leren hoe ideeën en klantwensen worden vertaald naar concrete requirements en developmenttaken
* Samenwerken met developers, testers en collega's uit andere disciplines
* Aanschuiven bij code reviews en leren hoe je feedback geeft én ontvangt
* Meedenken over technische documentatie en softwarekwaliteit
* Nieuwe technologieën en ontwikkelingen volgen en jouw kennis delen met het team

Je krijgt daarbij volop ruimte om vragen te stellen, nieuwe dingen uit te proberen en stap voor stap zelfstandiger te worden.


### **Jouw eigen stageproject**


Naast het meewerken in het team werk je aan een eigen, afgebakend project. We kijken samen welk onderwerp het beste bij jou past. Een aantal voorbeelden:


* **End\-to\-end testautomatisering met Playwright**
  

Onderzoek hoe onze applicaties momenteel worden getest en ontdek hoe testautomatisering kan bijdragen aan de kwaliteit van onze software. Je zet een Playwright\-testframework op, implementeert geautomatiseerde regressietests en levert documentatie en advies op voor toekomstig gebruik.
* **AI\-assisted development**
  

AI verandert de manier waarop software wordt ontwikkeld. Jij onderzoekt hoe AI\-tools binnen development kunnen worden ingezet, welke kansen en aandachtspunten er zijn en hoe we hier binnen Paragon op een goede manier mee kunnen omgaan. Je werkt richtlijnen, voorbeelden en best practices uit en presenteert je bevindingen aan het team.
* **Security en penetratesten**
  

Duik in de wereld van applicatiebeveiliging. Je ondersteunt bij beveiligingstesten, analyseert bevindingen en denkt mee over verbetermaatregelen waarmee de veiligheid van onze applicaties verder kan worden versterkt.
* **Heb je zelf een interessant idee voor een stageproject?**
  

Ook daar staan we voor open. Als jouw idee aansluit bij Business ICT, gaan we graag samen met jou kijken naar de mogelijkheden.

### **Wat ga je leren?**


Deze stage geeft je een kijkje in de volledige softwareontwikkelcyclus. Je leert onder andere:


* Hoe software wordt ontwikkeld binnen een professionele Agile\-organisatie
* Hoe een idee wordt vertaald naar requirements, ontwikkeling, testen en productie
* Werken met moderne technologieën zoals C\#/.NET en Azure
* Samenwerken binnen een multidisciplinair team
* Werken met code reviews en testautomatisering
* Hoe je softwarekwaliteit en security meeneemt in je werk
* Hoe IT en business samenkomen binnen een organisatie

### **Dit ben jij?**


Je bent een nieuwsgierige HBO\-ICT\-student die graag wil ontdekken hoe het er in de praktijk écht aan toegaat. Je hoeft nog geen expert te zijn. We vinden het vooral belangrijk dat je wilt leren en initiatief durft te nemen. Verder:


* Volg je een **HBO\-opleiding in de richting ICT of Software Engineering**, bijvoorbeeld HBO\-ICT of Technische Informatica
* Zit je in een fase van je opleiding waarin een stage past
* Heb je basiskennis van softwareontwikkeling en bij voorkeur C\#/.NET
* Heb je interesse in cloudtechnologie en bij voorkeur al enige kennis van Azure
* Communiceer je duidelijk, zowel mondeling als schriftelijk
* Ben je leergierig, nieuwsgierig en proactief
* Kun je zelfstandig werken, maar weet je ook wanneer je hulp of feedback moet vragen
* Werk je graag samen met anderen

### **Wat mag je van ons verwachten?**


Bij Paragon krijg je meer dan alleen een plek om je stage\-uren te maken. Je krijgt de ruimte om jezelf te ontwikkelen en praktijkervaring op te doen binnen een ervaren Business ICT\-team. Je kunt rekenen op:


* Een leerzame stage van 4 maanden of iets langer
* Persoonlijke begeleiding door een vaste, ervaren Product Developer
* Praktijkervaring met C\#/.NET en Azure
* De mogelijkheid om je te verdiepen in onder andere testautomatisering, AI\-assisted development of security
* Een eigen stageproject met een concreet en toetsbaar eindresultaat
* Een marktconforme stagevergoeding
* Een laptop die je tijdens je stage kunt gebruiken
* Een informele en open werksfeer waarin je wordt aangemoedigd om vragen te stellen, ideeën te delen en te groeien
* Mogelijkheid tot deels thuiswerken, in overleg
* En wie weet: bevalt het van beide kanten goed en is er na je studie een passende vacature? Dan kijken we graag samen naar de mogelijkheden om bij Paragon te blijven werken.

### **Praktische informatie**


**Duur:** \+/\- 4 maanden, of afgestemd op jouw studieprogramma
  

**Omvang:** bij voorkeur 32\-40 uur per week, in overleg
  

**Standplaats:** Apeldoorn, met mogelijkheid tot deels thuiswerken in overleg
  

**Begeleiding:** wekelijkse begeleiding, tussentijdse evaluaties en een eindevaluatie
  

**Voorzieningen:** je krijgt een laptop ter beschikking tijdens je stage


### **Over Paragon**


Paragon maakt deel uit van een wereldwijd opererende organisatie die bedrijven ondersteunt bij het optimaliseren van hun klantcommunicatie en interactie. Paragon groeit organisch en we faciliteren klantcommunicatie voor vooraanstaande (internationale) organisaties. We hebben grote ambities om verder te groeien. Wil jij bijdragen aan de uitbreiding van ons succes?


### **Enthousiast geworden? We maken graag kennis met jou!**


**Stuur snel je cv, een korte motivatie en je stageopdracht of leerbehoefte naar** **hrm@paragon\-cc.nl**


**Vertel ons vooral waar jij enthousiast van wordt en wat je tijdens je stage wilt leren. Wie weet verwelkomen we jou binnenkort als onze nieuwe Product Developer stagiair!**


**Vragen over de stage? Bel gerust met Nick Massa, Technology Director: 06\-10013100\.**

------------------------------



Team Tomorrow is een team van zo'n 90 collega’s met een breed palet aan skills. Wij vernieuwen de manier waarop Deloitte werkt door interne processen te optimaliseren, innovatieve technische oplossingen te implementeren en in bredere zin de manier waarop onze collega's werken naar een hoger niveau te tillen. Als Software Engineer maak je deel uit van onze groep Builders. Wij zijn verantwoordelijk voor het leveren van technische oplossingen, het ontwikkelen van snelle prototypes en het als technisch aanspreekpunt fungeren voor collega's die niet bij dat deel van deze oplossingen betrokken zijn.


**How do you do this?**
-----------------------



Als Software Engineer ben je actief betrokken bij de ontwikkeling van onze oplossingen, in samenwerking met designers, product owners en andere engineers, én met stakeholders binnen de business. Je bent nieuwsgierig van aard; in het AI\-tijdperk is alleen code schrijven voor jou niet genoeg. Je wilt begrijpen hoe en waarom code werkt, en waarom bepaalde oplossingen binnen een specifieke context worden gekozen. Je hebt oog voor detail en pakt proactief door bij het bouwen van nieuwe features en/of oplossingen. Jouw expertise is waardevol in alle stappen van het proces, van idee tot product.


Naast bouwen hecht je ook waarde aan groei en leren, voor jezelf en voor je collega's. We nodigen je uit om van ons te leren en ons van jou te laten leren. Dat kan gaan over een niche\-onderwerp waar jij door gegrepen bent of over de nieuwste versie van een front\-end framework.


Daarnaast vinden wij eigenaar\- en vakmanschap belangrijk. We verwachten niet dat je bij binnenkomst alles begrijpt en/of beheerst, maar wel dat je jezelf hierin blijft ontwikkelen. Je hebt een stevige basis en bouwt van daaruit graag verder richting complexere vraagstukken en oplossingen. AI is je versneller, niet je vervanger. Naast alle bovengenoemde punten hebben we een aantal indicatoren of deze rol bij je past:

* Je hebt een gedegen basiskennis van een taal als C\#, Java, Python of een vergelijkbare taal en hebt daar een aantal jaren mee gewerkt in een productieomgeving.
* Daarnaast heb je frameworks of plugins geïntegreerd met behulp van package managers en ben je bekend met de ecosystemen rondom de hierboven genoemde talen.
* Samenwerken staat centraal: je bent gewend om met Git te werken en kunt je werk delen via GitHub of een vergelijkbare omgeving. Dat betekent ook dat je je code goed kunt toelichten, zowel schriftelijk als mondeling.
* Je bent nieuwsgierig, creatief en sociaal. We verwachten niet dat je meteen voor de hele groep staat te presenteren, maar je bent communicatief van aard, durft anderen op hun ideeën te bevragen en staat open voor constructieve feedback.
* Innovatie is onze core business, dus we verwachten dat je trends volgt en/of actief nieuwe dingen leert.

NN is in beweging om een data gedreven organisatie te worden. Als Azure/DataBricks Data engineer gebruik jij je kennis en ervaring met de nieuwste data technologieën om van data informatie te maken.

  

  

Je hebt ruime ervaring met data\- en software engineering best practices en ontwikkelt schaalbare, robuuste en herbruikbare oplossingen die op enterprise schaal door meerdere teams worden toegepast. Je bent in staat om zelfstandig te werken, neemt eigenaarschap over je oplossingen en weet effectief om te gaan met een complex stakeholderlandschap binnen een platformomgeving met veel teams. Je weet mensen mee te nemen in je oplossingen, kunt complexe technische concepten begrijpelijk uitleggen en bent didactisch sterk in het begeleiden van teams.

  

  

Samen met je collega engineers bouw jij elke dag nieuwe functionaliteiten om onze klanten optimaal te kunnen bedienen.

  

  

Jouw impact als data engineer bij NN


Het Life \& Pensions Data Analytics Platform (LPDAP) is het centrale data¬platform waarop data voor het volledige Life \& Pensions domein wordt ingenomen, verrijkt en ontsloten om herbruikbare dataproducten te bouwen voor interne en externe afnemers.

  

  

Het LPDAP kent een ambitieuze roadmap voor 2026 voor verbetering en uitbreiding. Daarvoor is het LEAP programma opgezet en zetten wij de nieuwste technologie van Microsoft in, zoals Azure Data Factory en Azure Databricks. Verder ga je veel werken met Azure DevOps en Git. Programmeren ga je vooral doen in Python, SQL en PySpark.

  

  

Samen met je collega’s bouw jij aan best practices en generieke data capabilities voor data pipelines, die door meerdere DevOps teams gebruikt kunnen worden. Denk hierbij standaarden/richtlijnen en aan herbruikbare capabilities, zoals data quality, orchestratie, logging/monitoring. Je gaat voor herbruikbaarheid, kwaliteit, en neemt vanzelfsprekend non\-functional requirements hierin mee.

  

  

Databricks en Azure zijn hierbij je grootste vriend. Je werkt daarvoor nauw samen met de vele data engineers, die aan data pipelines werken. Je wordt in dit proces ook ondersteund door onze cloud engineers, die zorgen dat jij je werk zo efficiënt mogelijk kan doen. Je denkt mee met je collega’s hoe de DevOps teams zo goed mogelijk met de capabilties worden bediend en hoe de gebruikers de data zo simpel mogelijk uit het platform kunnen halen. Zo maak je het werk voor iedereen een stuk makkelijker.

  

  

**Wat je gaat doen**


* Continue implementatie en verbetering van (nieuwe) generieke, herbuikbare capabilities voor data pipelines, te gebruiken door de DevOps teams
* Samenwerken met collega data engineers en platform engineers voor integreren van de capabilities op ons data platform
  

  

**Wat wij jou bieden**


Onze mensen zijn de drijvende kracht van de organisatie. Dat geldt niet alleen voor onze interne medewerkers, maar ook voor onze interim professionals. De specialistische kennis en ervaring die jij in huis hebt, is voor ons van grote waarde. Wij bieden jou:


* Marktconform uurtarief afhankelijk van jouw kennis en ervaring
* Begindatum 1 oktober, met een duur van 6 maanden
* Hybride werken, deels vanuit huis en deels op kantoor
* Internationale werkomgeving met veel kennisdeling
  

  

**Wat je meebrengt**


Jouw analytische brein en assertieve “can do” mentaliteit komt hier volledig tot zijn recht: je mag je tanden zetten in ambitieuze uitdagingen, waar je samen met je collega’s hard aan werkt om tijdig te kunnen leveren conform de afgesproken requirements en tijdslijnen. Je schuwt geen vraag om inzicht te krijgen in wat er speelt en duikt met een kritische blik het platform in. Ondertussen volg je alle ontwikkelingen in infrastructuur en andere delen van je vakgebied. Verder heb je:


* Een flinke dosis kennis van Azure. Azure en Databricks certificering zijn een grote pré
* Ervaring met programmeren in Python, PySpark en SQL
* Ervaring met Azure Data Factory, Azure Databricks, Azure DevOps, CI/CD en software engineering
* Ervaring met of kennis van data engineering tools en best practices
* Een “can do” en “automation\-first” mentaliteit en je moet in staat zijn om binnen korte (inwerk)tijd mee te draaien in het team
* Minimaal B1 niveau Engels, vloeiend Nederlands is een pré
* Je hebt passie voor IT en Data en ervaring met Agile werken
  

  

**Met wie je werkt**


Je komt in een Enablement team met collega data engineers, allen met hun eigen specialiteiten. Je werkt daarbij op één (LPDAP) platform nauw samen met meerdere DevOps teams en stakeholders binnen het Life \& Pensions domein, waarbij afstemming en heldere communicatie essentieel zijn.

  

  

Jij brengt veel ervaring met en kennis van Databricks en Azure met je mee zodat het team de ambities en doelstelling van het Life\&Pensions Data Analytics Platform kan waarmaken. We blijven onszelf altijd verbeteren en halen graag het beste in elkaar naar boven. Om dat te doen praten we écht met elkaar zodat we elkaar leren kennen en zo weten hoe we het beste uit elkaar kunnen halen. We gaan scrummend de werkweek door met een dagelijkse stand\-up, een tweewekelijkse review en retrospective. En daar houdt ons samenwerken niet op. We werken hybride maar zijn één dag in de week te vinden op kantoor. Omdat de meeste van onze directe collega’s op kantoor in Rotterdam zijn te vinden zal dat hoofdzakelijk daar zijn maar het kan ook voorkomen dat we een keer werken op onze vestiging in Amsterdam of Den Haag. We weten elkaar continu te vinden voor het delen van kennis en vragen. Je kunt echt op je collega’s rekenen.

  

  

Bij NN werken we hybride. Deels vanuit huis en deels op kantoor. Teams ontmoeten elkaar digitaal, fysiek of hybride. Je spreekt samen met je team af wat het beste past. We hebben onze kantoren zo ingericht dat er voor elk type werk een passende plek is. De officiële standplaats van deze functie is Rotterdam. Als Data engineer werk je in dat geval direct naast Rotterdam Centraal, boven het Nationale\-Nederlanden DE Café. In ons restaurant eet je een gezonde lunch en bieden we je ook een uitgebreide Aziatische keuken.

  

  

**Heb je vragen?**

Stel je vraag aan Rowena Taal
**Bij** **NN** **geloven we dat onze verschillen ons sterker maken.**


We verwelkomen talent in alle vormen en waarderen de unieke ervaringen, achtergronden, perspectieven en kwaliteiten die iedereen meebrengt. Daarom bouwen we aan een inclusieve werkomgeving waarin iedereen zich welkom, gewaardeerd en vrij voelt om zichzelf te zijn.


Twijfel je of je aan alle functie\-eisen voldoet? Laat dat je niet tegenhouden om te solliciteren. We zijn niet alleen geïnteresseerd in je ervaring, maar ook in je motivatie, je potentieel en de impact die je wilt maken.

We werken ongeveer twee dagen per week samen op locatie LAB073 in ’s\-Hertogenbosch.


We zoeken iemand die energie krijgt van samenwerken, initiatief toont en verantwoordelijkheid neemt voor het eindresultaat. Je bent communicatief sterk, analytisch ingesteld en durft technische keuzes te maken.


Daarnaast verwachten we dat je een voortrekkersrol neemt in de verdere ontwikkeling van onze AI\-first werkwijze. Je helpt het team om AI optimaal te benutten en draagt actief bij aan het verhogen van de engineeringkwaliteit binnen Team Plasma.


Wij zoeken nadrukkelijk een engineer die technologie en AI combineert om complexe businessvraagstukken op te lossen en zo directe impact maakt op de energietransitie.


We vinden het belangrijk dat je je bij ons thuis voelt. We zijn allemaal anders en het mooie daarvan is dat we elkaar vanuit die verschillen aanvullen. We hebben elkaars perspectieven en meningen nodig voor een succesvolle energietransitie! Lees hier mee over ons beleid op diversiteit en inclusie.

new_jobs.title: MES/MOM Developer
new_jobs.description:
**Fantastic challenges. Amazing opportunities.**


GKN Aerospace is reimagining air travel: going further, faster and greener! Fuelled by great people whose expertise and creativity sets the standards in our industry, we’re inspired by the opportunities to innovate and break boundaries. We’re proud to play a part in protecting the world’s democracies. And we’re committed to putting sustainability at the centre of everything we do, opening up and protecting our planet. With over 16,000 employees across 32 manufacturing sites in 12 countries we serve over 90% of the world’s aircraft and engine manufacturers and achieved sales of £3\.6bn in 2025\. There are no limits to where you can take your career.


**Job Summary**
---------------


As MES/MOM engineer at GKN Aerospace in Papendrecht, The Netherlands, you will be involved in the Development, Implementation, Validation and Support of our Manufacturing Execution System (MES) solution based on Siemens Opcenter Execution, deployed at sites in the APAC, EU and NA regions.


**Job Responsibilities**
------------------------


* Support and maintain current MES deployments in multiple Production sites.
* Package and deploy new GKN customization releases to Test and Production environments.
* Install/upgrade and configure Opcenter for new implementations and deployments.
* Set up and maintain integrations with surrounding applications using Opcenter Connect MOM.
* Understand business processes and functional requirements and convert into technical specifications.
* Translate functional and design specifications into MES objects: workflows, equipment classes, etc.
* Develop custom logic when justified by a valid business case and no out of the box solution is available.
* Define test specifications, participate in tests and validation.
* Develop tools and templates to speed up the design process, make the support process more efficient and increase application stability and usability.
* Conduct technical training when required to share development best practices.
**Job Qualifications**
----------------------


To help us make a difference, you’ll bring your passion and talent for what you do along with the following skills, experience, qualifications and attributes:

  

* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, or equivalent work experience.
* Minimum of 5 years of working experience in a similar role.
* Extensive experience in Windows server administration, application management and configuration including IIS, certificates, services, firewall, Powershell.
* Experience with Kubernetes and managing applications running as Docker Containers an
* Extensive experience in Oracle/MS SQL database management and query methods.
* Experience with Siemens Opcenter Execution (formerly known as Camstar), including Designer, Portal Studio, Opcenter Connect MOM or similar experience.
* Experience with Mendix development.
* Knowledge of basic programming languages such as .NET, HTML, C\+\+/C\#, XML/XSL/XSD, VB Script.
* Experience in supporting and troubleshooting applications, ideally in the field of manufacturing or production.
* Experience in supporting the implementation of software solutions and participating in IT projects.
* Strong commitment and responsibility to maintain and support production environments.
* Eagerness to expand current knowledge and learn new skills.
* Strong verbal and written English communication skills, Dutch would be a plus.
* Ability to work in multi\-cultural environments, team player.
* Willingness to travel.
  

**What do we offer?**


We are committed to offer you fantastic challenges and amazing opportunities, a career that can go in many directions thanks to our breadth of international opportunities. By being part of GKN Fokker Aerospace that has proven itself to be at the cutting edge of our industry, you will know that you will be working towards being the most trusted partner in the aerospace industry.
  

In the role of MES\\MOM Systems Developer/Engineer you will belong to an international team of experts. We will not only provide you with the conditions to perform at the best of your capabilities, but we will also support and promote your professional and personal development. Furthermore, we will offer you:  

  



* A gross monthly salary in scale K for a medior at € 3\.952 up to € 5\.715,\- depending on your work experience,
* 8% holiday allowance,
* 40 paid holidays for full\-time employment in line with the Collective Labor Agreement Metalektro (27 holidays and 13 ADV days),
* An excellent pension scheme (PME) and travel allowance,
* Hybrid working, giving you the opportunity to balance home and office working,
* Profit sharing scheme,
* A pleasant and informal working environment, in which we work together to achieve the best result for our customers.
  

Next to a competitive package, we will offer you a world of opportunities: we want to see your career fly! We will support your career progression by providing you with learning and development opportunities. That's the beauty of being part of a global business, once you're on board you never know where your career journey may take you!

  

We’ll offer you fantastic challenges and amazing opportunities. This is your chance to be part of an organisation that has proven itself to be at the cutting edge of our industry; and is committed to pushing the boundaries even further. And with some of the best training on offer in the industry, who knows how far you can go?


**A Great Place to work needs a Great Way of Working**


Everyone is welcome to apply to GKN. We believe that we can only achieve our ambitions through a coming together of diverse minds who enjoy collaborating in an inspirational environment. Through our commitment to diversity, inclusion and belonging and by living our five powerful principles we’ve created a culture where everyone feels welcome to contribute. It’s a culture that won us ‘The Best Workplace Culture Award’. By embracing and celebrating what makes us unique we encourage everyone to bring their full self to work.


We’re also committed to providing an accessible recruitment process, so if you require reasonable adjustments at any stage during our recruitment process please get in touch and let us know.


We are the place where human dreams, plus human endeavour, shape the future of aerospace innovation and technology.

new_jobs.title: Senior Full-Stack Engineer
new_jobs.description:
* *Research shows that male candidates often feel confident enough to apply when they meet about 60% of the job requirements, whereas female candidates tend to apply only when they meet all the criteria. If this role truly suits you but you’re unsure whether you meet every requirement, we would still love to hear from you.*

#### **About Virtual Vaults**


Virtual Vaults is the leading data room provider in the Benelux and expanding rapidly across Europe. Founded to simplify and accelerate dealmaking for the mid\-market, it has become the trusted partner for advisors and deal teams who value clarity, control, and speed. The platform brings preparation, diligence, and closing together in one connected environment, supported by transparent pricing and a customer success team that stays engaged at every stage. By reducing friction and cost while improving quality, Virtual Vaults helps dealmakers move faster and close with confidence.

#### **From idea to production**


You have a knack for turning unclear challenges into clear, actionable plans. You bring people together, drive decisions, and follow through to ensure solutions deliver real value. Because for you, the job isn’t finished when the code is merged. It’s finished when the outcome works for the people who depend on it.


We're looking for a hands\-on senior engineer to join our Workspaces or Data Room team. You'll work across .NET, Angular, and Azure, using AI to support your engineering work and building AI capabilities into our products. You'll help shape the solution, write the code, and stay involved through release and production operations.


You’ll be part of a multidisciplinary team that combines different perspectives to build the best possible product. Together with a team lead, medior developers, QA engineers and product designers, you’ll collaborate closely to solve complex challenges, refine ideas, and deliver valuable solutions. Everyone contributes to shaping the product, and you’ll have the opportunity to influence both technical decisions and overall user experience.

#### **What you will own**

* **Delivery from start to finish**. Clarify requirements with your team, agree what success looks like, and take features through implementation, testing, release, and production verification. Close the follow\-up work too.
* **A workable plan for complex problems.** Break projects and operational changes into manageable steps. Make dependencies and risks visible, identify a useful first release, and adjust the plan as you learn. Keep an overview of the whole process.
* **Clear, proactive communication.** Keep colleagues and stakeholders informed without waiting to be asked. Raise risks early, explain the trade\-offs, and bring a recommendation. Present your work in team discussions and product demos.
* **Full\-stack engineering.** Build and maintain backend services, frontend experiences, and infrastructure as code. Contribute to architecture, automated testing, performance, and safe delivery.
* **Practical AI.** Use coding assistants and agents thoughtfully, reviewing and testing their output. Build AI\-enabled features and evaluate their usefulness, accuracy, security, cost, and latency.
* **Reliable, secure operation.** Help respond to incidents, investigate root causes, assess risks, and complete improvements that prevent repeat problems. Protect customer data throughout the system.
* **A stronger team**. Be a technical leader, share knowledge, review code, mentor colleagues, and welcome constructive challenges.


Ownership here is shared accountability, not doing everything alone. We value people who involve others early, ask for help when needed, and keep responsibility for the outcome.

#### **What you will bring to the table**

##### **Your way of working**


A track record of finishing substantial work. You can explain what you personally delivered, how you handled setbacks, and how you knew the result was working in production.

* The ability to create structure when requirements are incomplete, coordinate across teams, and keep progress moving without repeated chasing.
* Excellent spoken and written English (minimum C1 level). You can lead a technical discussion, write a precise update, and explain a complex issue to a non\-technical colleague. Dutch is a strong plus.

##### **Your engineering foundation**

* **C\# / .NET:** 6\+ years of professional C\# development, with recent hands\-on experience building and maintaining production services and APIs.
* **Angular / TypeScript:** Practical production experience and the ability to independently deliver the frontend side of a feature, not only its backend.
* **Azure and delivery:** Hands\-on experience with Azure PaaS, containers, infrastructure as code, CI/CD, and production troubleshooting. AI\-200 (or AZ\-204\) certification is a plus.
* **Messaging:** Experience with Azure Service Bus or equivalent, including retries, duplicate delivery, and failure recovery.
* **Quality and security:** Automated testing, pragmatic architecture, safe releases, and a security\-first approach. You understand tenant\-scoped authorization, least privilege, secrets management, and keeping sensitive information out of logs.
* **Education:** A bachelor's or master's degree in computer science, software engineering, or a related field.

##### **AI is part of the basics**

* You use AI coding tools in your development workflow and can show how you check their output, catch mistakes, and protect confidential code and data through approved tooling.
* You've implemented AI features or working prototypes and can explain your contribution and how you evaluated the results.
* You understand large language models (LLMs), embeddings, vector search, and retrieval\-augmented generation (RAG), including their limitations and when they are useful.
* You understand Model Context Protocol (MCP) and how it connects AI applications to tools and data with authenticated, least\-privilege access.
* You account for hallucinations and prompt injection, enforce tenant authorization before retrieval or tool execution, and keep sensitive prompts, document contents, and personal data out of logs. You don't rely on prompts to enforce access control.


We're looking for practical application engineering and sound judgment, not a model\-training specialist.

#### **What we offer you**


A hands\-on role with room to influence both the product and how it's built. You'll work in an open, flat, collaborative team where sharing knowledge, asking questions, and improving the way we work are part of the job.

* Salary: €6\.000 – €7\.500 depending on skills and experience
* 32\-40 hours per week with flexible working hours (hybrid work, with 3 days in the office and 2 days from home, based on 40 hours per week
* 27 vacation days.
* 100% pension contribution paid by Virtual Vaults.
* NS Business Card for commute, or a allowance of 23ct per kilometer (based on living a minimum of 10km from the office)
* Training budget for personal and professional development
* A professional, ambitious and informal work environment
* Fun company events and team outings
* Daily fresh lunch and fruit provided at the office

#### **Let's talk**

* **An informal video call (15\-30 minutes):** We'll discuss your experience, what you're looking for, and the role.
* **An onsite interview with potential future colleagues (60 minutes)**: We'll explore the work you've delivered, how you approach complex problems, and your engineering and AI experience. There will be time for your questions, too. It will be a two\-way conversation, to make sure you van also determine if we are a match for you.
* **A case, which is to be made at home:** You’ll work on a case that mirrors a real\-world challenge. We’re interested not just in the end result, but also in how you think, prioritize, and solve problems.
* **Onsite case presentation (60 minutes):** You’ll present your case to the team and talk us through your reasoning, choices, and conclusion. It’s a chance for us to learn more about how you work and for you to get a feel for how we collaborate.
* **An offer** if we're a mutual match.
**Interested?** Apply with your CV and motivation.

***Disclaimer for Recruitment Agencies:*** *Virtual Vaults does not accept unsolicited CVs or candidate profiles. Without a prior written agreement, any submissions become the property of Virtual Vaults and no compensation will be owed.*

new_jobs.title: Trainee Automation Developer - Regio Oss
new_jobs.description:
**Heb je net je AI\-, Data Science\- of vergelijkbare studie afgerond? Beschik je over een basis in bijvoorbeeld Python of heb je een oprechte passie voor technologie? En wil je je kennis verder verdiepen in de wereld van (Hyper)automation, RPA en AI?** 

Als je de ambitie hebt om jezelf te ontplooien tot een expert die complexe problemen tackelt en strategisch advies geeft, dan is dit je kans! Lees verder en ontdek de mogelijkheden als Trainee Automation Developer bij The Public Network!

**Wat ga je doen?**

The Public Network (TPN) biedt jou, in samenwerking met onze partner MvR Digital Workforce (DW), de unieke gelegenheid om een veelbelovende carrière te starten in de wereld van Hyperautomation. MvR DW is toonaangevend in deze sector en omarmt de nieuwste technologische ontwikkelingen. Samen leiden we je op tot een volwaardige Automation\-specialist, specifiek voor een lokale overheidsinstelling in de regio Oss.

Als Trainee Automation Developer \& Consultant werk je mee aan uitdagende projecten, waaronder:

· **Technische Analyse:** Je duikt in de technische behoeften en spot de kansen die Hyperautomation bieden. Dit betekent dat je bestaande systemen doorgrondt en uitzoekt hoe nieuwe automatiseringsoplossingen hier naadloos in passen, inclusief de integratie van softwarerobots en hun impact op bestaande processen.

· **Ontwikkeling en Implementatie:** Je ontwerpt, ontwikkelt en implementeert digitale assistenten met behulp van UiPath en andere RPA\-technologieën. Hierbij bepaal je de optimale aanpak en timing voor implementatie, volledig afgestemd op de specifieke wensen van de stakeholders.

· **Advies en Communicatie:** Je adviseert proactief over de beste RPA\-oplossingen en communiceert effectief met zowel technische teams als besluitvormers. Je begeleidt anderen door het hele proces, van probleemidentificatie tot implementatie, en stemt je aanpak continu af op basis van feedback en veranderende behoeften.

· **Projectmanagement:** Je bewaakt de voortgang van projecten, zorgt voor een perfecte afstemming van alle onderdelen en past het tempo aan om de allerbeste resultaten te boeken.

**Wat ga je leren?**

Bij The Public Network begeleiden we je stap voor stap in het fascinerende vak van Automation. Je traineeship begint met een intensieve, vijf weken durende UiPath\-training, waarin je de fijne kneepjes van het ontwikkelen van digitale assistenten leert. Daarnaast investeren we veel in de ontwikkeling van jouw persoonlijk leiderschap.

Het traineeship bestaat uit drie leerlijnen:

· **Vakinhoudelijke leerlijn:** Je maakt je de kernexpertises van UiPath en RPA eigen, samen met methoden zoals Scrum en LEAN. Ook krijg je training in systeemintegratie en diverse RPA\-technologieën, zodat je perfect voorbereid bent op het oplossen van technische uitdagingen.

· **Professionele leerlijn:** We focussen op het ontwikkelen van essentiële advies\- en communicatieve vaardigheden die cruciaal zijn in je rol als consultant. Denk hierbij aan integriteit, klantgerichte communicatie en verandermanagement. Je kiest zelf de onderwerpen die jou het meest aanspreken en groeit zo in de richting die het beste bij jou past.

· **Persoonlijk Leiderschapstraject:** Jouw persoonlijke ontwikkeling staat centraal in dit traineeship. Gedurende de eerste anderhalf jaar word je intensief begeleid door een coach bij je persoonlijke leiderschapsontwikkeling. Dit programma omvat theoretische en praktijkgerichte opdrachten, een tweedaagse sessie en intervisiesessies, allemaal gericht op het ontdekken en verder ontwikkelen van jouw kwaliteiten. Persoonlijk leiderschap versterkt niet alleen jouw positie als consultant, maar ook je verdere carrière en leven.

**Na het traineeship?**

Na het succesvol afronden van je traineeship, dat ongeveer 1,5 jaar duurt, stroom je door naar een vaste functie bij een lokale overheidsinstelling in de regio Oss. In deze rol ga je zelfstandig aan de slag met Automation\-projecten en word je onderdeel van een team dat zich bezighoudt met Hyperautomation. Je blijft je vaardigheden verfijnen en specialiseert je verder in specifieke onderdelen van RPA en AI, zoals procesautomatisering en systeemintegratie.

Daarnaast biedt deze functie volop mogelijkheden om je verder te ontwikkelen. In overleg met de opdrachtgever kun je jouw ambities verder realiseren, bijvoorbeeld door je te specialiseren in Hyperautomation of andere geavanceerde technologieën. Zo kun je jouw carrière verder vormgeven en je expertise uitbreiden in de richting die het beste aansluit bij jouw interesses en doelen.

**Hoe kom je in aanmerking voor ons traineeship?**

· Je hebt een Bachelor\- of WO\-opleiding afgerond in AI, Data Science of een gerelateerd vakgebied;

· Je hebt affiniteit met techniek en de wens om je kennis verder uit te breiden;

· Je hebt de ambitie om te groeien en hecht waarde aan persoonlijke ontwikkeling;

· Je houdt van duidelijke afspraken, korte lijntjes, neemt verantwoordelijkheid, ziet kansen en bent assertief.

**Wat krijg je ervoor terug?**

· Een bruto startsalaris van € 3000 op basis van 36 uur;

· Een programma voor persoonlijk leiderschap als fundering voor jouw verdere leven;

· Een opleiding tot Automation Developer inclusief alle vereiste certificaten;

· Jij bepaalt waar en hoe je werkt in samenspraak met je opdrachtgever;

· 25 vakantiedagen en 8% vakantiegeld;

· Kostenvrij reizen met een NS\-Business kaart en kilometervergoeding;

· Individuele begeleiding met een ervaren coach om je persoonlijke ambities te verwezenlijken;

· De kans om snel te groeien, afgestemd op jouw ambities en wensen;

new_jobs.title: Scientific Software Engineer C++ (MSc/PhD)
new_jobs.description:
***Scientific Software Engineer C\+\+ (MSc/PhD)***

**Wat ga je doen?**

Je ondersteunt High Tech opdrachtgevers, in de Randstad, met jouw technische expertise en oplossingsgericht denken. Je werkt met de nieuwste technologieën en draagt bij aan het bouwen van slimme, duurzame oplossingen. Tegelijkertijd ontwikkel je jezelf als engineer én als persoon. Je wordt hierbij begeleid en ondersteunt in jouw persoonlijke ontwikkeling door zeer ervaren managers die klaar staan om te helpen waar nodig.

Je krijgt de kans om vanaf conceptfase tot implementatie bij te dragen aan uitdagende R\&D projecten binnen sectoren zoals industrie, agro, healthcare en hightech systemen.

Je bent naast het implementeren ook vooral bezig met nadenken over design en architectuur waarbij je een sterke focus legt op kwaliteit en betrouwbaarheid van de door jou ge\-engineerde oplossingen.

**Jouw rol als Scientific software engineer:**

Als Scientific Software Engineer ontwikkel je geavanceerde softwareapplicaties voor het modelleren, simuleren en analyseren van complexe wetenschappelijke data. Je schrijft hoogwaardige code in talen zoals C\+\+, C\#, Python of Fortran, en implementeert numerieke algoritmen, datamodellen en performance optimalisaties. Je werkt nauw samen met researchers en data scientists om op maat gemaakte software oplossingen te ontwikkelen. Met een sterke focus op kwaliteit en efficiëntie ontwikkel jij cruciale applicaties en tools die bijdragen aan geavanceerde innovaties bijvoorbeeld op het vlak van predictive en preventive maintenance en 3D simulaties.

Daarnaast kom je ook in aanraking met onderwerpen als A.I., Machine Learning, HPC, CFD, FEM en ook zaken als object detection middels point clouds en 3D\-camera’s spreken je aan en deins je niet voor terug.

You join a team with a growing portfolio and increasing responsibilities. In this role, you create scalable solutions, reduce manual effort and strengthen continuity by sharing expertise and removing single points of failure. You work hands‑on while also shaping ways of working, aligning stakeholders, and helping NN move forward as a true supporter of change.


**What are you going to do**
  

You translate complex workplace challenges into reliable, repeatable engineering solutions. Your work improves automation, quality, security and the employee experience. You combine hands\-on engineering with technical direction, standardisation and knowledge sharing.


Your key responsibilities


* Design, build and maintain modern macOS and Mobile workplace solutions
* Develop and operate Azure\-based automation for device provisioning, configuration, compliance and lifecycle management
* Automate recurring operational activities and simplify processes through standardisation and reusable engineering patterns
* Validate, test and manage endpoint hardware and peripherals, including compatibility, stability, performance and security
